                f"historical result for {key!r} is "
                f"{row.get('disposition')!r}/{row.get('typed_reason')!r}"
            )
    return problems


def _finalize_from_journals(
    *, args: argparse.Namespace, cells: list[dict], active: dict,
    stage_root: Path, final_dir: Path, matrix: dict, matrix_path: Path,
    matrix_sha256: str, authority_path: Path, pins: dict, pins_path: Path,
    aggregate_budget_path: Path, output_root: Path, source_commit: str,
    run_journal_path: Path, run_rows: list[dict],
) -> Path:
    if set(active) != {_cell_safe_name(cell) for cell in cells} or any(
        result is None for _start, result in active.values()
    ):
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "FINALIZATION_JOURNALS_INCOMPLETE", repr(sorted(active))
        )
    preflight_hashes = {
        start["capture_preflight_sha256"] for start, _result in active.values()
    }
    preflight_paths = {
        start["capture_preflight_path"] for start, _result in active.values()
    }
    if len(preflight_hashes) != 1 or len(preflight_paths) != 1:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "DONE_PREFLIGHT_NONUNIFORM",
            f"hashes={sorted(preflight_hashes)!r}; paths={sorted(preflight_paths)!r}",
        )
    preflight_sha = next(iter(preflight_hashes))
    original_preflight_path = Path(next(iter(preflight_paths)))
    original_preflight = _validate_referenced_preflight(
        preflight_path=original_preflight_path,
        expected_sha256=preflight_sha, pins=pins, pins_path=pins_path,
        aggregate_budget_path=aggregate_budget_path, matrix=matrix,
        matrix_path=matrix_path, matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
        output_root=output_root, expected_head=source_commit,
        require_fresh=False,
    )
    admission = _admission_object(
        run_rows, preflight_sha256=preflight_sha,
        preflight_generated_at_utc=original_preflight["generated_at_utc"],
    )
    invocation_ids = {
        row["run_id"] for row in admission["capture_invocations"]
    }
    for safe_name, (start, result) in active.items():
        if (
            start["admission_run_id"] not in invocation_ids
            or result["capture_preflight_sha256"] != preflight_sha
        ):
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "DONE_ADMISSION_INCONSISTENT", safe_name
            )

    publication_root = (
        stage_root / "publications" / hashlib.sha256(uuid.uuid4().bytes).hexdigest()
    )
    publication_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    results: list[dict] = []
    for cell in cells:
        safe_name = _cell_safe_name(cell)
        start, result = active[safe_name]
        source_cell = (stage_root / "journals" / safe_name / "cells" / safe_name)
        destination_cell = publication_root / "cells" / safe_name
        destination_cell.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copytree(source_cell, destination_cell, symlinks=False)
        _verify_journal_artifacts(
            result, root=publication_root, safe_name=safe_name,
        )
        results.append(result)

    head_post, clean_post, dirty_post = _git_state()
    if head_post != source_commit or not clean_post:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "source_state_changed",
            f"pre={source_commit}, post={head_post}, dirty={dirty_post!r}",
        )
    import campaign_done_manifest as done  # noqa: E402
    membership = [
        {
            "roster_source": cell["identity"]["roster_source"],
            "slug": cell["identity"]["slug"],
            "authority_cell_sha256": cell["authority_cell_sha256"],
        }
        for cell in cells
    ]
    manifest = done.build_done_manifest(
        command=shlex.join(sys.argv),
        source_commit_pre=source_commit,
        source_commit_post=head_post,
        working_tree_clean=True,
        tool_versions=done._tool_versions_from_pins(pins),
        output_root=str(final_dir),
        expected_cells=len(cells),
        chunk_membership=membership,
        cell_results=results,
        pins_sha256=sha256_file(pins_path),
        roster_authority_sha256=sha256_file(authority_path),
        trace_budget_sha256=sha256_file(aggregate_budget_path),
        capture_matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
        matrix_seal_sha256=matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
        preflight_sha256=preflight_sha,
        admission=admission,
        input_paths={
            "pins": str(pins_path),
            "roster_authority": str(authority_path),
            "trace_budget": str(aggregate_budget_path),
            "capture_matrix": str(matrix_path),
            "preflight": str(original_preflight_path),
        },
        chunk_id=args.chunk_id,
        protocol_version=pins["measurement_protocol"]["version"],
        arch=pins["arch"],
        generated_at_utc=_utc_text(),
        repo_root=REPO_ROOT,
        verification_output_root=publication_root,
    )
    done._assert_schema_valid(manifest)
    problems = done.verify_seal(
        manifest, repo_root=REPO_ROOT,
        verification_output_root=publication_root,
        require_current_head=True, require_clean_tree=True,
    )
    if problems:
        raise ChunkRefusal("done_seal_invalid", "; ".join(problems))
    _write_json_exclusive_fsync(publication_root / "DONE.json", manifest)
    final_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.replace(publication_root, final_dir)
    published_manifest = _json(final_dir / "DONE.json")
    resumed = done.verify_seal(
        published_manifest, repo_root=REPO_ROOT,
        require_current_head=True, require_clean_tree=True,
    )
    if resumed:
        raise ChunkRefusal("finalized_seal_invalid", "; ".join(resumed))
    return final_dir


def run_chunk(args: argparse.Namespace) -> Path:
    matrix_path = Path(args.matrix).resolve()
    authority_path = Path(args.authority).resolve()
    pins_path = Path(args.pins).resolve()
    aggregate_budget_path = Path(args.aggregate_budget).resolve()
    cell_budget_path = Path(args.cell_budgets).resolve()
    try:
        registry_path = _lexical_absolute_path(Path(args.metric_registry))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "matrix_metric_registry_path_invalid", str(exc),
        ) from exc
    preflight_path = Path(args.preflight).resolve()
    output_root = Path(args.output_root)
    _assert_external_output_root(output_root)
    # Keep this descriptor live for the whole function. flock is released on
    # return, exception unwinding, or process exit.
    _campaign_lock = acquire_campaign_lock(output_root)

    matrix = _json(matrix_path)
    bound_metric_registry = bind_matrix_metric_registry(
        matrix, registry_path,
    )
    try:
        sidecar_schema = label_import.load_schema()
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "label_sidecar_schema_authority_invalid", str(exc),
        ) from exc
    authority = validate_matrix_inputs(
        matrix, matrix_path=matrix_path, authority_path=authority_path,
        pins_path=pins_path, aggregate_budget_path=aggregate_budget_path,
        cell_budget_path=cell_budget_path, registry_path=registry_path,
        bound_metric_registry=bound_metric_registry,
    )
    chunk, cells = select_chunk(matrix, args.chunk_id)
    head_pre, clean_pre, dirty = _git_state()
    if head_pre != matrix["source_commit"] or not clean_pre:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "source_state_invalid",
            f"HEAD={head_pre}, expected={matrix['source_commit']}, dirty={dirty!r}",
        )
    capture_defects_by_cell = _capture_defect_state(
        output_root=output_root, cells=cells, source_commit=head_pre,
    )
    final_dir = output_root / "chunks" / args.chunk_id
    if final_dir.exists():
        import campaign_done_manifest as done  # noqa: E402
        done_path = final_dir / "DONE.json"
        if not done_path.is_file():
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "finalized_chunk_missing_done", f"{final_dir} has no DONE.json"
            )
        resume_manifest = _json(done_path)
        resume_problems = done.verify_seal(
            resume_manifest, repo_root=REPO_ROOT, require_current_head=True,
            require_clean_tree=True,
        )
        resume_problems.extend(_historical_chunk_matches(
            resume_manifest, cells=cells, chunk_id=args.chunk_id,
        ))
        if not resume_problems:
            return final_dir
        historical_problems = done.verify_seal(
            resume_manifest, repo_root=REPO_ROOT, require_current_head=False,
            require_clean_tree=False,
        )
        historical_problems.extend(_historical_chunk_matches(
            resume_manifest, cells=cells, chunk_id=args.chunk_id,
        ))
        if not historical_problems:
            if done._is_historical_bootstrap(resume_manifest):
                return final_dir
            historical_problems.append(
                "historical non-bootstrap chunk must be revision-archived and "
                "recaptured at the current matrix HEAD"
            )
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "finalized_chunk_resume_invalid",
            "current=" + "; ".join(resume_problems)
            + " | historical=" + "; ".join(historical_problems),
        )

    pins = _json(pins_path)
    matrix_sha = sha256_file(matrix_path)
    stage_root = (
        output_root / ".staging" / head_pre / args.chunk_id / matrix_sha
    )
    stage_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    journals_root = stage_root / "journals"
    superseded_root = stage_root / "superseded"
    run_journal_path = stage_root / "chunk_run_journal.jsonl"
    _validate_superseded_tree(superseded_root)
    session_id, run_rows = _chunk_session(
        run_journal_path, chunk_id=args.chunk_id, source_commit=head_pre,
        matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
        matrix_seal_sha256=matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
    )
    active = _active_journals(
        journals_root=journals_root, cells=cells,
        matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
        matrix_seal_sha256=matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
        source_commit=head_pre,
    )
    preparation_failures_by_cell = _preparation_failure_backrefs_by_cell(
        output_root=output_root, cells=cells, source_commit=head_pre,
    )
    _require_active_preparation_backrefs(
        active, preparation_failures_by_cell,
    )
    _require_active_capture_defect_backrefs(
        active, capture_defects_by_cell,
    )
    all_complete = (
        set(active) == {_cell_safe_name(cell) for cell in cells}
        and all(result is not None for _start, result in active.values())
    )
    if all_complete:
        _record_finalization_probe(
            run_journal_path=run_journal_path, session_id=session_id,
            chunk_id=args.chunk_id, matrix=matrix, matrix_path=matrix_path,
        )
        run_rows = _read_jsonl(
            run_journal_path, error_code="CHUNK_RUN_JOURNAL_INVALID"
        )
        return _finalize_from_journals(
            args=args, cells=cells, active=active, stage_root=stage_root,
            final_dir=final_dir, matrix=matrix, matrix_path=matrix_path,
            matrix_sha256=matrix_sha, authority_path=authority_path,
            pins=pins, pins_path=pins_path,
            aggregate_budget_path=aggregate_budget_path,
            output_root=output_root, source_commit=head_pre,
            run_journal_path=run_journal_path, run_rows=run_rows,
        )

    admitted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    preflight_sha = sha256_file(preflight_path)
    preflight_manifest = _validate_referenced_preflight(
        preflight_path=preflight_path, expected_sha256=preflight_sha,
        pins=pins, pins_path=pins_path,
        aggregate_budget_path=aggregate_budget_path, matrix=matrix,
        matrix_path=matrix_path, matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
        output_root=output_root, expected_head=head_pre,
        require_fresh=True, admitted_at_utc=admitted_at,
    )
    try:
        sol_environment_probe, certified_sol_env = (
            sol_env.certify_sol_environment(
                matrix, matrix_path=matrix_path, ambient=os.environ,
            )
        )
    except sol_env.SolEnvironmentRefusal as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal(exc.code, exc.detail) from exc
    sealed_sol_probe = preflight_manifest["checks"]["sol_environment"]
    stable_probe_fields = (
        "ambient", "environment_contract", "environment_contract_sha256",
        "constructed_environment_delta", "matrix_pin", "matrix_sha256",
        "observed_fingerprint", "compiler_identity", "nvcc_release",
        "nvcc_version_output",
    )
    drift = [
        name for name in stable_probe_fields
        if sol_environment_probe.get(name) != sealed_sol_probe.get(name)
    ]
    if drift:
        raise ChunkRefusal("SOL_ENV_PREFLIGHT_DRIFT", repr(drift))

    mismatched = {
        safe_name: pair for safe_name, pair in active.items()
        if pair[0]["capture_preflight_sha256"] != preflight_sha
    }
    if mismatched:
        classifications = [
            _original_preflight_status(
                start=start, current_preflight_sha256=preflight_sha,
                current_preflight_path=preflight_path,
                pins=pins, pins_path=pins_path,
                aggregate_budget_path=aggregate_budget_path, matrix=matrix,
                matrix_path=matrix_path, matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
                output_root=output_root, expected_head=head_pre,
                admitted_at_utc=admitted_at,
            )
            for start, _result in mismatched.values()
        ]
        fresh_details = [
            detail for status, detail in classifications if status == "fresh"
        ]
        if fresh_details:
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "JOURNAL_PREFLIGHT_MISMATCH",
                "; ".join(fresh_details)
                + "; re-present the original preflight",
            )
        supersedable_detail = "; ".join(
            detail for _status, detail in classifications
        )
        if not getattr(args, "supersede_stale_journals", False):
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "JOURNAL_PREFLIGHT_SUPERSEDABLE", supersedable_detail
            )
        _supersede_active_journals(
            journals_root=journals_root, superseded_root=superseded_root,
            active=active, current_preflight_sha256=preflight_sha,
            session_id=session_id, chunk_id=args.chunk_id,
            source_commit=head_pre,
            matrix_seal_sha256=matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
            allow_overflow=getattr(args, "allow_supersession_overflow", False),
        )
        active = {}
    elif any(result is None for _start, result in active.values()):
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "CELL_JOURNAL_INCOMPLETE",
            "an interrupted attempt under the current preflight cannot be "
            "recaptured in place; preserve it until explicit stale supersession",
        )

    # The preparation-attempt bound is a chunk admission condition.  Check
    # every journal that would be opened before the first cell can perform GPU
    # work; checking only inside the capture loop could capture an earlier cell
    # before a later cell's third-attempt refusal.
    for cell in cells:
        safe_name = _cell_safe_name(cell)
        if safe_name not in active:
            _require_preparation_attempt_available(
                safe_name=safe_name,
                backrefs=preparation_failures_by_cell.get(safe_name, []),
                allow_overflow=getattr(
                    args, "override_preparation_attempt_limit", False
                ),
            )

    run_id = hashlib.sha256(uuid.uuid4().bytes).hexdigest()
    admitted_at_text = _utc_text(admitted_at)
    admission_row = _record_capture_admission(
        run_journal_path, session_id=session_id, chunk_id=args.chunk_id,
        run_id=run_id, admitted_at_utc=admitted_at_text,
        preflight_path=preflight_path, preflight_sha256=preflight_sha,
        preflight_generated_at_utc=preflight_manifest["generated_at_utc"],
    )
    run_rows.append(admission_row)
    cell_budgets = load_trace_budgets(cell_budget_path)
    capture_provenance_base = {
        "protocol_version": pins["measurement_protocol"]["version"],
        "source_commit": head_pre,
        "capture_matrix_sha256": matrix_sha,
        "preflight_sha256": preflight_sha,
        "pins_sha256": sha256_file(pins_path),
        "trace_budget_sha256": sha256_file(cell_budget_path),
        "raw_staging_margin_bytes": matrix["input_pins"][
            "aggregate_retention_budget"
        ]["raw_staging_margin_bytes"],
        "admission_run_id": run_id,
    }
    supersedes_by_cell = _latest_supersession_backrefs(
        superseded_root, current_preflight_sha256=preflight_sha,
    )
    journals_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for cell in cells:
        safe_name = _cell_safe_name(cell)
        journal_dir = journals_root / safe_name
        result = _load_or_recover_cell_journal(
            journal_dir=journal_dir, cell=cell, matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
            matrix_seal_sha256=matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
            preflight_sha256=preflight_sha, source_commit=head_pre,
            current_invocation_admitted=True,
            original_preflight_status="fresh",
            current_preflight_path=preflight_path,
        )
        if result is None:
            capture_started_at = _utc_text()
            supersedes = supersedes_by_cell.get(safe_name)
            prior_preparation_failures = preparation_failures_by_cell.get(
                safe_name, []
            )
            prior_capture_defect_attempts = capture_defects_by_cell.get(
                safe_name, []
            )
            _require_preparation_attempt_available(
                safe_name=safe_name,
                backrefs=prior_preparation_failures,
                allow_overflow=getattr(
                    args, "override_preparation_attempt_limit", False
                ),
            )
            start = _journal_start_payload(
                cell=cell, matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
                matrix_seal_sha256=matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
                preflight_sha256=preflight_sha,
                preflight_path=preflight_path, source_commit=head_pre,
                capture_started_at_utc=capture_started_at,
                admission_run_id=run_id, supersedes=supersedes,
                prior_preparation_failures=prior_preparation_failures,
                prior_capture_defect_attempts=prior_capture_defect_attempts,
            )
            journal_dir.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
            _write_cell_journal(journal_dir / JOURNAL_START_NAME, start)
            cell_dir = journal_dir / "cells" / safe_name
            cell_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            capture_provenance = {
                **capture_provenance_base,
                "capture_started_at_utc": capture_started_at,
                "supersedes": supersedes,
                "prior_preparation_failures": prior_preparation_failures,
                "prior_capture_defect_attempts": (
                    prior_capture_defect_attempts
                ),
            }
            result = capture_cell(
                cell=cell, cell_dir=cell_dir, matrix=matrix, pins=pins,
                cell_budgets=cell_budgets,
                expected_tracer_sha256=(
                    preflight_manifest["checks"]["injection_runtime"]
                    ["tracer_so_sha256"]
                ),
                capture_provenance=capture_provenance,
                certified_sol_env=certified_sol_env,
                sol_environment_probe=sol_environment_probe,
                module_store=output_root / "module_store",
                metric_registry=bound_metric_registry,
                sidecar_schema=sidecar_schema,
            )
            _verify_journal_artifacts(
                result, root=journal_dir, safe_name=safe_name,
            )
            _write_cell_journal(
                journal_dir / JOURNAL_COMPLETE_NAME,
                _journal_payload(start=start, result=result),
            )
    live_capture_guard(pins)
    active = _active_journals(
        journals_root=journals_root, cells=cells,
        matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
        matrix_seal_sha256=matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
        source_commit=head_pre,
    )
    run_rows = _read_jsonl(
        run_journal_path, error_code="CHUNK_RUN_JOURNAL_INVALID"
    )
    return _finalize_from_journals(
        args=args, cells=cells, active=active, stage_root=stage_root,
        final_dir=final_dir, matrix=matrix, matrix_path=matrix_path,
        matrix_sha256=matrix_sha, authority_path=authority_path,
        pins=pins, pins_path=pins_path,
        aggregate_budget_path=aggregate_budget_path,
        output_root=output_root, source_commit=head_pre,
        run_journal_path=run_journal_path, run_rows=run_rows,
    )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--matrix", default=str(DEFAULT_MATRIX))
    parser.add_argument("--authority", default=str(DEFAULT_AUTHORITY))
    parser.add_argument("--pins", default=str(DEFAULT_PINS))
    parser.add_argument("--aggregate-budget", default=str(DEFAULT_AGGREGATE_BUDGET))
    parser.add_argument("--cell-budgets", default=str(DEFAULT_CELL_BUDGETS))
    parser.add_argument("--metric-registry", default=str(DEFAULT_REGISTRY))
    parser.add_argument("--preflight", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--chunk-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-root", required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--supersede-stale-journals", action="store_true",
        help=(
            "atomically preserve every active journal before recapturing a "
            "chunk whose original preflight is no longer usable"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--allow-supersession-overflow", action="store_true",
        help=(
            "permit a third or later supersession only after explicit "
            "operator escalation"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--override-preparation-attempt-limit", action="store_true",
        help=(
            "permit a third or later pre-GPU preparation attempt only after "
            "explicit operator escalation"
        ),
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.allow_supersession_overflow and not args.supersede_stale_journals:
        parser.error(
            "--allow-supersession-overflow requires "
            "--supersede-stale-journals"
        )
    try:
        final_dir = run_chunk(args)
    except ChunkRefusal as exc:
        print(f"sm86_capture_chunk: REFUSED [{exc.code}] {exc.detail}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"sm86_capture_chunk: INPUT ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print(f"sm86_capture_chunk: SEALED {final_dir}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

class WorkloadCaptureRefusal(RuntimeError):
    """Fail-closed supplemental capture refusal with a stable code."""

    def __init__(self, code: str, detail: str):
        self.code = code
        self.detail = detail
        super().__init__(f"{code}: {detail}")

    driver_version: str

@dataclass(frozen=True)

STORAGE_CAPACITY_ERRNOS = frozenset({errno.ENOSPC, errno.EDQUOT})
STORAGE_INTEGRITY_ERRNOS = frozenset({
    errno.EIO, errno.EROFS,
    *(
        value for value in (
            getattr(errno, "ENXIO", None), getattr(errno, "ESTALE", None),
        ) if value is not None
    ),
})
STORAGE_CAPACITY_CODE = "supplemental_storage_capacity_exhausted"
STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CODE = "supplemental_storage_integrity_failure"


def storage_refusal_from_exception(
    exc: BaseException, *, operation: str,
) -> WorkloadCaptureRefusal | None:
    """Map write/fsync/rename OS failures into the closed storage taxonomy."""
    current: BaseException | None = exc
    observed: OSError | None = None
    while current is not None:
        if isinstance(current, OSError):
            observed = current
            break
        current = current.__cause__ or current.__context__
    if observed is None:
        return None
    if observed.errno in STORAGE_CAPACITY_ERRNOS:
        code = STORAGE_CAPACITY_CODE
    elif observed.errno in STORAGE_INTEGRITY_ERRNOS or observed.errno is None:
        code = STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CODE
    else:
        return None
    detail = json.dumps({
        "operation": operation,
        "errno": observed.errno,
        "error": str(observed),
    }, sort_keys=True)
    return WorkloadCaptureRefusal(code, detail)


class _CampaignLockLease:
    """Own the canonical campaign lock outside a failing chunk frame."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._stream: Any | None = None
        self._path: Path | None = None

    def acquire(self, output_root: Path) -> None:
        if self._stream is not None:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "campaign_lock_invalid",
                "supplemental chunk attempted to acquire its campaign lock twice",
            )
        stream = canonical_capture.acquire_campaign_lock(output_root)
        self._stream = stream
        self._path = output_root / ".capture.lock"

    def close(self, *, preserve_active_failure: bool) -> None:
        stream = self._stream
        path = self._path
        self._stream = None
        self._path = None
        if stream is None:
            return
        try:
            stream.close()
        except OSError as exc:
            if preserve_active_failure:
                # The capture refusal remains the authoritative first fault.
                # Closing the descriptor is still attempted exactly once.
                return
            mapped = storage_refusal_from_exception(
                exc, operation="campaign_chunk_lock_close",
            )
            if mapped is not None:
                raise mapped from exc
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "campaign_lock_invalid", f"{path}: close: {exc}"
            ) from exc


def _raise_output_path_error(
    exc: OSError, *, path: Path, component: str, operation: str,
) -> None:
    """Prefer the closed storage taxonomy over a generic path refusal."""
    storage_refusal = storage_refusal_from_exception(
        exc, operation=operation,
    )
    if storage_refusal is not None:
        raise storage_refusal from exc
    raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
        "supplemental_output_component_invalid",
        f"{path}: {component}: {exc}",
    ) from exc


def _walk_directory_nofollow(path: Path, *, create: bool) -> None:
    """Traverse/create an absolute directory using dirfds and O_NOFOLLOW."""
    if ".." in path.parts:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_output_component_invalid", str(path)
        )
    absolute = path.absolute()
    if not absolute.is_absolute():
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_output_component_invalid", str(path)
        )
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
    try:
        descriptor = os.open("/", flags)
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_output_path_error(
            exc, path=absolute, component="/",
            operation="output_directory_root_open",
        )
    try:
        for component in absolute.parts[1:]:
            try:
                child = os.open(component, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    return
                try:
                    os.mkdir(component, mode=0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
                except OSError as exc:
                    _raise_output_path_error(
                        exc, path=absolute, component=component,
                        operation="output_directory_mkdir",
                    )
                try:
                    child = os.open(component, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                except OSError as exc:
                    _raise_output_path_error(
                        exc, path=absolute, component=component,
                        operation="output_directory_open_after_mkdir",
                    )
            except OSError as exc:
                _raise_output_path_error(
                    exc, path=absolute, component=component,
                    operation="output_directory_open",
                )
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = child
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _mkdir_nofollow(path: Path, *, exist_ok: bool) -> None:
    existed = path.exists() and not path.is_symlink()
    if path.is_symlink():
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_output_component_invalid", str(path)
        )
    if existed and not exist_ok:
        raise FileExistsError(path)
    _walk_directory_nofollow(path, create=True)


def _write_bytes_new_nofollow(
    path: Path, payload: bytes | bytearray, *, mode: int, operation: str,
) -> None:
    """Create, write, and fsync one output file with local storage typing."""
    _mkdir_nofollow(path.parent, exist_ok=True)
    parent_flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
    try:
        parent_fd = os.open(path.parent, parent_flags)
        try:
            descriptor = os.open(
                path.name,
                os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL
                | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0),
                mode, dir_fd=parent_fd,
            )
            try:
                view = memoryview(payload)
                while view:
                    written = os.write(descriptor, view)
                    if written <= 0:
                        raise OSError(None, "short exclusive output write")
                    view = view[written:]
                os.fsync(descriptor)
            finally:
                os.close(descriptor)
            os.fsync(parent_fd)
        finally:
            os.close(parent_fd)
    except FileExistsError:
        raise
    except OSError as exc:
        mapped = storage_refusal_from_exception(exc, operation=operation)
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        # A short write without an errno is an integrity failure at this
        # explicit output boundary, never an input error.
        if exc.errno is None:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CODE,
                json.dumps({
                    "operation": operation, "errno": None,
                    "error": str(exc),
                }, sort_keys=True),
            ) from exc
        raise


def _open_regular_nofollow(
    path: Path, *, role: str,
) -> tuple[int, Path, os.stat_result]:
    """Open one lexical path without following any ancestor or leaf symlink."""
    lexical = Path(path)
    if ".." in lexical.parts:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_path_invalid", f"{role}: {lexical}"
        )
    absolute = lexical.absolute()
    parts = absolute.parts[1:]
    if not parts:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_not_regular", f"{role}: {absolute}"
        )
    directory_flags = (
        os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
        | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
    )
    descriptor = os.open("/", directory_flags)
    try:
        for component in parts[:-1]:
            child = os.open(component, directory_flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = child
        file_descriptor = os.open(
            parts[-1],
            os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
            | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0) | getattr(os, "O_NONBLOCK", 0),
            dir_fd=descriptor,
        )
    except OSError as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_path_invalid", f"{role}: {absolute}: {exc}"
        ) from exc
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    observed = os.fstat(file_descriptor)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(observed.st_mode):
        os.close(file_descriptor)
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_not_regular", f"{role}: {absolute}"
        )
    return file_descriptor, absolute, observed


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    descriptor, _absolute, _observed = _open_regular_nofollow(
        path, role="SHA-256 input"
    )
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        while True:
            block = os.read(descriptor, 1 << 20)
            if not block:
                break
            digest.update(block)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _output_storage_refusal(
    exc: BaseException, *, operation: str,
) -> WorkloadCaptureRefusal | None:
    """Map only a known campaign-output operation into storage taxonomy."""
    return storage_refusal_from_exception(exc, operation=operation)


def _read_output_regular_nofollow(
    path: Path, *, role: str, operation: str,
) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    """Read one known output artifact; preserve the first read/close fault."""
    try:
        descriptor, _absolute, observed = _open_regular_nofollow(
            path, role=role,
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=f"{operation}_open")
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise
    active_error: BaseException | None = None
    try:
        chunks: list[bytes] = []
        while True:
            block = os.read(descriptor, 1 << 20)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        return b"".join(chunks), observed
    except BaseException as exc:
        active_error = exc
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=f"{operation}_read")
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            os.close(descriptor)
        except OSError as exc:
            if active_error is None:
                mapped = _output_storage_refusal(
                    exc, operation=f"{operation}_close",
                )
                if mapped is not None:
                    raise mapped from exc
                raise


def _sha256_output_file(path: Path, *, role: str, operation: str) -> str:
    """Hash a known output artifact without classifying unrelated inputs."""
    try:
        descriptor, _absolute, _observed = _open_regular_nofollow(
            path, role=role,
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=f"{operation}_open")
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise
    active_error: BaseException | None = None
    try:
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        while True:
            block = os.read(descriptor, 1 << 20)
            if not block:
                break
            digest.update(block)
        return digest.hexdigest()
    except BaseException as exc:
        active_error = exc
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=f"{operation}_read")
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            os.close(descriptor)
        except OSError as exc:
            if active_error is None:
                mapped = _output_storage_refusal(
                    exc, operation=f"{operation}_close",
                )
                if mapped is not None:
                    raise mapped from exc
                raise


def _fsync_output_regular_nofollow(
    path: Path, *, role: str, operation: str,
) -> None:
    """Fsync one known output file without following a replaced symlink."""
    try:
        descriptor, _absolute, _observed = _open_regular_nofollow(
            path, role=role,
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=f"{operation}_open")
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise
    active_error: BaseException | None = None
    try:
        os.fsync(descriptor)
    except BaseException as exc:
        active_error = exc
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=f"{operation}_fsync")
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            os.close(descriptor)
        except OSError as exc:
            if active_error is None:
                mapped = _output_storage_refusal(
                    exc, operation=f"{operation}_close",
                )
                if mapped is not None:
                    raise mapped from exc
                raise


def _load_output_object(
    path: Path, *, role: str, operation: str,
    require_canonical: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, _observed = _read_output_regular_nofollow(
        path, role=role, operation=operation,
    )
    try:
        if require_canonical:
            return _parse_canonical_object_payload(payload, role=role)
        return _parse_object_payload(payload, role=role)
    except WorkloadCaptureRefusal as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_invalid", f"{role}: {path}: {exc.detail}",
        ) from exc


def _output_lstat(path: Path, *, operation: str) -> os.stat_result | None:
    try:
        return path.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    except OSError as exc:
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=operation)
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise


def _resolve_output_path(
    path: Path, *, operation: str, strict: bool = True,
) -> Path:
    try:
        return path.resolve(strict=strict)
    except OSError as exc:
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(exc, operation=operation)
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise


def _output_directory_entries(
    directory: Path, *, operation: str,
) -> list[Path]:
    try:
        with os.scandir(directory) as entries:
            return [
                Path(entry.path)
                for entry in sorted(entries, key=lambda item: item.name)
            ]
    except OSError as exc:
        mapped = _output_storage_refusal(
            exc, operation=f"{operation}_scandir",
        )
        if mapped is not None:
            raise mapped from exc
        raise


def _output_tree_paths(root: Path, *, operation: str) -> list[Path]:
    """Walk a known output tree without pathlib's suppressed OSError path."""
    paths: list[Path] = []

    def walk(directory: Path) -> None:
        try:
            with os.scandir(directory) as entries:
                observed = sorted(entries, key=lambda item: item.name)
        except OSError as exc:
            mapped = _output_storage_refusal(
                exc, operation=f"{operation}_scandir",
            )
            if mapped is not None:
                raise mapped from exc
            raise
        for entry in observed:
            path = Path(entry.path)
            paths.append(path)
            try:
                is_directory = entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False)
            except OSError as exc:
                mapped = _output_storage_refusal(
                    exc, operation=f"{operation}_entry_stat",
                )
                if mapped is not None:
                    raise mapped from exc
                raise
            if is_directory:
                walk(path)

    walk(root)
    return paths


def _git_blob_bytes(
    source_commit: str, repository_path: str, *, repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
) -> bytes | None:
    """Return raw committed bytes, or ``None`` when the path is not tracked."""
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", source_commit) is None:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_source_commit_invalid", source_commit
        )
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    for name in (
        "GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES", "GIT_COMMON_DIR", "GIT_DIR",
        "GIT_INDEX_FILE", "GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY", "GIT_PREFIX",
        "GIT_WORK_TREE",
    ):
        environment.pop(name, None)
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "cat-file", "blob",
         f"{source_commit}:{repository_path}"],
        capture_output=True, check=False, env=environment,
    )
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        return completed.stdout
    missing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "cat-file", "-e",
         f"{source_commit}:{repository_path}"],
        capture_output=True, check=False, env=environment,
    )
    if missing.returncode != 0:
        return None
    raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
        "supplemental_git_blob_unreadable",
        f"{source_commit}:{repository_path}: {completed.stderr[-400:]!r}",
    )


def input_file_identity(
    path: Path, *, role: str, source_commit: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Create a relocation-safe identity and retained-owner path.

    Absolute paths, devices, and inodes are deliberately excluded.  A tracked
    input is bound to its raw Git blob at ``source_commit``.  Every other input
    is rebound into this campaign's owner namespace by exact bytes.
    """
    descriptor, absolute, observed = _open_regular_nofollow(path, role=role)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    payload = bytearray()
    try:
        while True:
            block = os.read(descriptor, 1 << 20)
            if not block:
                break
            digest.update(block)
            payload.extend(block)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    role_name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", role.lower()).strip("_")
    if not role_name:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_role_invalid", role
        )
    retained = (
        Path("sol_workload_campaign/inputs/source") / source_commit
        / role_name / absolute.name
    ).as_posix()
    common = {
        "role": role_name,
        "size_bytes": observed.st_size,
        "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
        "retained_owner_relative_path": retained,
    }
    try:
        repository_path = absolute.relative_to(REPO_ROOT.absolute()).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        repository_path = None
    if repository_path is not None:
        committed = _git_blob_bytes(source_commit, repository_path)
        if committed is not None:
            committed_sha = hashlib.sha256(committed).hexdigest()
            if committed != bytes(payload):
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_tracked_input_drift",
                    f"{repository_path}: live={common['sha256']} "
                    f"git_blob={committed_sha}",
                )
            return {
                **common,
                "kind": "tracked_git_blob",
                "repository_path": repository_path,
                "source_commit": source_commit,
                "git_blob_sha256": committed_sha,
            }
    return {
        **common,
        "kind": "retained_external_input",
        "owner_marker_name": SUPPLEMENTAL_ROOT_MARKER,
        "owner_relative_path": retained,
        "source_name": absolute.name,
    }


def _portable_input_reference(identity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Project one runtime identity into the closed relocatable DONE union."""
    common = {
        "kind": identity.get("kind"),
        "role": identity.get("role"),
        "size_bytes": identity.get("size_bytes"),
        "sha256": identity.get("sha256"),
    }
    if identity.get("kind") == "tracked_git_blob":
        retained = identity.get("retained_owner_relative_path")
        return {
            **common,
            "repository_path": identity.get("repository_path"),
            "source_commit": identity.get("source_commit"),
            "git_blob_sha256": identity.get("git_blob_sha256"),
            "owner_relative_path": retained,
            "source_name": (
                Path(retained).name if isinstance(retained, str) else None
            ),
        }
    if identity.get("kind") == "retained_external_input":
        return {
            **common,
            "owner_relative_path": identity.get("owner_relative_path"),
            "source_name": identity.get("source_name"),
        }
    raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
        "supplemental_input_reference_invalid", repr(identity)
    )


def _safe_relative_path(value: Any, *, role: str) -> Path:
    path = Path(value) if isinstance(value, str) else Path(".")
    if (
        not isinstance(value, str) or not value
        or path.is_absolute() or "\\" in value
        or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in path.parts)
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_path_invalid", f"{role}: {value!r}"
        )
    return path


def _read_portable_input_reference(
    reference: dict[str, Any], *, campaign_root: Path, repo_root: Path,
    source_commit: str, verify_git_provenance: bool = False,
) -> bytes:
    """Resolve one DONE input without consulting its original live path."""
    role = reference.get("role")
    if not isinstance(role, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_]+", role):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_invalid", repr(reference)
        )
    kind = reference.get("kind")
    if kind == "tracked_git_blob":
        repository_path = _safe_relative_path(
            reference.get("repository_path"), role=role
        ).as_posix()
        if reference.get("source_commit") != source_commit:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_input_reference_commit_mismatch", role
            )
        if reference.get("git_blob_sha256") != reference.get("sha256"):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_input_reference_blob_mismatch", role
            )
        if verify_git_provenance:
            committed = _git_blob_bytes(
                source_commit, repository_path, repo_root=repo_root
            )
            if committed is None:
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_input_reference_blob_missing",
                    f"{source_commit}:{repository_path}",
                )
            if hashlib.sha256(committed).hexdigest() != reference.get(
                "git_blob_sha256"
            ):
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_input_reference_blob_mismatch", role
                )
    elif kind != "retained_external_input":
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_invalid", repr(reference)
        )
    if kind in {"tracked_git_blob", "retained_external_input"}:
        relative = _safe_relative_path(
            reference.get("owner_relative_path"), role=role
        )
        source_name = reference.get("source_name")
        if (
            not isinstance(source_name, str) or not source_name
            or source_name in {".", ".."} or "/" in source_name
            or "\\" in source_name
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_input_reference_path_invalid", role
            )
        path = campaign_root / relative
        payload, observed = _read_output_regular_nofollow(
            path, role=f"retained DONE input {role}",
            operation="retained_done_input_read",
        )
        if (
            observed.st_uid != os.geteuid()
            or observed.st_nlink != 1
            or observed.st_mode & 0o222
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_input_reference_owner_invalid", role
            )
    if (
        type(reference.get("size_bytes")) is not int
        or len(payload) != reference["size_bytes"]
        or hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != reference.get("sha256")
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_hash_mismatch", role
        )
    return payload


def _canonical_json_bytes(
    value: Any, *, ensure_ascii: bool = True,
) -> bytes:
    return (
        json.dumps(
            value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=ensure_ascii,
            allow_nan=False,
        ) + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


def _read_immutable_campaign_payload(path: Path, *, role: str) -> bytes:
    payload, observed = _read_output_regular_nofollow(
        path, role=role, operation="immutable_campaign_output_read",
    )
    if (
        observed.st_uid != os.geteuid()
        or observed.st_nlink != 1
        or observed.st_mode & 0o222
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_owner_invalid", role
        )
    return payload


def _parse_json_payload(payload: bytes, *, role: str) -> Any:
    """Parse strict UTF-8 JSON without duplicate keys or nonfinite numbers."""

    def reject_duplicates(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        parsed: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for key, value in pairs:
            if key in parsed:
                raise ValueError(f"duplicate key {key!r}")
            parsed[key] = value
        return parsed

    def reject_constant(value: str) -> Any:
        raise ValueError(f"nonfinite JSON number {value!r}")

    def finite_float(value: str) -> float:
        parsed = float(value)
        if not math.isfinite(parsed):
            raise ValueError(f"nonfinite JSON number {value!r}")
        return parsed

    try:
        text = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
        return json.loads(
            text,
            object_pairs_hook=reject_duplicates,
            parse_constant=reject_constant,
            parse_float=finite_float,
        )
    except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_json_invalid", f"{role}: {exc}"
        ) from exc


def _parse_object_payload(payload: bytes, *, role: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse one strict UTF-8 JSON object."""
    value = _parse_json_payload(payload, role=role)
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_json_invalid",
            f"{role}: root is not an object",
        )
    return value


def _parse_canonical_object_payload(
    payload: bytes, *, role: str, ensure_ascii: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = _parse_object_payload(payload, role=role)
    if payload != _canonical_json_bytes(value, ensure_ascii=ensure_ascii):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_json_invalid",
            f"{role}: noncanonical object",
        )
    return value


def _parse_v3_metric_registry(
    registry_document: dict[str, Any],
) -> metric_registry.MetricRegistry:
    """Parse retained registry-v2/label-v5 bytes independent of active vNext."""
    if (
        type(registry_document.get("registry_version")) is not int
        or registry_document.get("registry_version")
        != _V3_METRIC_REGISTRY_VERSION
        or type(registry_document.get("label_schema_version")) is not int
        or registry_document.get("label_schema_version")
        != _V3_SIDECAR_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):
        raise metric_registry.MetricRegistryError(
            "retained v3 registry must identify registry v2 / label schema v5"
        )

    # metric_registry's parser intentionally defaults to the active schema
    # version.  Adapt only that equality sentinel, after authenticating the
    # retained v5 value above; no metric row or registry semantic is rewritten.
    parser_document = copy.deepcopy(registry_document)
    parser_document["label_schema_version"] = metric_registry.LABEL_SCHEMA_VERSION
    parsed = metric_registry.parse_registry(parser_document)
    return replace(parsed, label_schema_version=_V3_SIDECAR_SCHEMA_VERSION)


def _load_v3_sidecar_authorities(
    input_payloads: dict[str, bytes],
) -> _V3SidecarAuthorities:
    """Parse the frozen v3/v5 profile solely from retained input bytes."""
    required = {"sidecar_schema", "metric_registry", "pins"}
    missing = sorted(required - set(input_payloads))
    if missing:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_sidecar_authority_invalid",
            f"missing retained authorities: {missing!r}",
        )
    try:
        schema_payload = input_payloads["sidecar_schema"]
        if not 1 <= len(schema_payload) <= _MAX_DONE_SCHEMA_BYTES:
            raise ValueError(
                f"sidecar schema size {len(schema_payload)} is outside the bound"
            )
        schema = _parse_object_payload(
            schema_payload, role="retained v3 sidecar schema",
        )
        properties = schema.get("properties")
        if not isinstance(properties, dict):
            raise ValueError("retained sidecar schema properties is not an object")
        schema_version_property = properties.get("schema_version")
        if not isinstance(schema_version_property, dict):
            raise ValueError(
                "retained sidecar schema properties.schema_version is not an object"
            )
        if (
            schema.get("$id") != _V3_SIDECAR_SCHEMA_ID
            or type(schema.get("schema_version")) is not int
            or schema.get("schema_version") != _V3_SIDECAR_SCHEMA_VERSION
            or schema_version_property.get("const")
            != _V3_SIDECAR_SCHEMA_VERSION
        ):
            raise ValueError("retained sidecar schema is not the v5 authority")
        jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)

        registry_document = _parse_object_payload(
            input_payloads["metric_registry"],
            role="retained v3 metric registry",
        )
        registry = _parse_v3_metric_registry(registry_document)
        if registry.label_schema_version != _V3_SIDECAR_SCHEMA_VERSION:
            raise ValueError("retained schema and registry versions are not aligned")
        expected_unit_metrics = tuple(
            canonical_capture.registry_unit_metrics(
                "sm_86", registry=registry,
            )
        )
        toolchain_contract.require_cycles_metric_in_collection(
            expected_unit_metrics
        )

        pins = _parse_object_payload(
            input_payloads["pins"], role="retained v3 protocol pins",
        )
        if (
            type(pins.get("schema_version")) is not int
            or pins.get("schema_version") != 1
            or pins.get("arch") != "sm_86"
            or pins.get("sku") != "rtx_3090_ti"
        ):
            raise ValueError("retained protocol pins do not identify sm_86/RTX 3090 Ti")
        toolchain = pins.get("toolchain")
        clocks = pins.get("reference_clock_state")
        protocol = pins.get("measurement_protocol")
        if not all(isinstance(value, dict) for value in (
            toolchain, clocks, protocol,
        )):
            raise ValueError("retained protocol pin sections are missing")
        assert isinstance(toolchain, dict)
        assert isinstance(clocks, dict)
        assert isinstance(protocol, dict)
        ncu_version_prefix = toolchain_contract.normalized_ncu_version_prefix(
            toolchain.get("ncu_version_prefix")
        )
        release = toolchain_contract.require_nvcc_release(
            toolchain.get("nvcc_release"), _V3_CUDA_RELEASE,
            code="SOL_ENV_NVCC_RELEASE_MISMATCH",
        )
        driver_version = toolchain.get("driver_version")
        persistence_mode = clocks.get("persistence_mode")
        sm_clock_mhz = clocks.get("sm_clock_mhz")
        mem_clock_mhz = clocks.get("mem_clock_mhz")
        if (
            not isinstance(driver_version, str)
            or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+){1,3}", driver_version)
            is None
            or persistence_mode != "Enabled"
            or type(sm_clock_mhz) is not int or sm_clock_mhz <= 0
            or type(mem_clock_mhz) is not int or mem_clock_mhz <= 0
            or protocol.get("version") != "v2.1"
            or protocol.get("ncu_clock_control") != "none"
            or protocol.get("ncu_cache_control") != "all"
            or protocol.get("ncu_replay_mode") != "kernel"
        ):
            raise ValueError("retained protocol pin values are invalid")
        for document in (schema, registry_document, pins):
            json.dumps(document, allow_nan=False)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_sidecar_authority_invalid", str(exc),
        ) from exc

    return _V3SidecarAuthorities(
        sidecar_schema=copy.deepcopy(schema),
        metric_registry=registry,
        expected_unit_metrics=expected_unit_metrics,
        ncu_version_prefix=ncu_version_prefix,
        nvcc_release=(release["major"], release["minor"]),
        driver_version=driver_version,
        persistence_mode=persistence_mode,
        sm_clock_mhz=sm_clock_mhz,
        mem_clock_mhz=mem_clock_mhz,
        ncu_clock_control=protocol["ncu_clock_control"],
        ncu_cache_control=protocol["ncu_cache_control"],
        ncu_replay_mode=protocol["ncu_replay_mode"],
        sidecar_schema_sha256=hashlib.sha256(schema_payload).hexdigest(),
        metric_registry_sha256=hashlib.sha256(
            input_payloads["metric_registry"]
        ).hexdigest(),
        pins_sha256=hashlib.sha256(input_payloads["pins"]).hexdigest(),
    )


def _load_v3_execution_authorities(
    *, matrix: dict[str, Any], preflight_payload: bytes,
    source_commit: str, chunk_id: str, matrix_sha256: str,
    row_key: dict[str, Any], selected_attempt_ordinal: int,
    sidecar_authorities: _V3SidecarAuthorities,
    repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
) -> _V3ExecutionAuthorities:
    """Derive row-local tool/path authority without trusting result receipts.

    The retained preflight v1 contract authenticates the capture output root and
    NCU version, but it never recorded the resolved NCU exporter path or bytes.
    That absence is retained as an explicit gap; callers refuse at the receipt
    boundary rather than treating the receipt's self-description as authority.
    """
    if (
        not isinstance(matrix, dict)
        or matrix.get("source_commit") != source_commit
        or not isinstance(chunk_id, str) or not chunk_id
        or not isinstance(matrix_sha256, str)
        or SHA256_RE.fullmatch(matrix_sha256) is None
        or type(selected_attempt_ordinal) is not int
        or selected_attempt_ordinal <= 0
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
            "matrix/chunk/attempt authority shape",
        )
    safe_name = _safe_name(row_key)
    preflight_document = _parse_object_payload(
        preflight_payload, role="retained selected capture preflight",
    )
    checks = preflight_document.get("checks")
    if not isinstance(checks, dict):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
            "retained preflight checks is not an object",
        )
    trace_budget = checks.get("trace_budget")
    ncu_probe = checks.get("ncu")
    if not isinstance(trace_budget, dict) or not isinstance(ncu_probe, dict):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
            "retained preflight trace_budget/ncu check is not an object",
        )
    output_root_value = trace_budget.get("output_root")
    output_root = (
        Path(output_root_value) if isinstance(output_root_value, str)
        else Path(".")
    )
    if (
        not isinstance(output_root_value, str) or not output_root_value
        or not output_root.is_absolute() or "\\" in output_root_value
        or ".." in output_root.parts
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
            f"retained preflight output root: {output_root_value!r}",
        )
    if (
        ncu_probe.get("status") != preflight.STATUS_OK
        or ncu_probe.get("expected") != sidecar_authorities.ncu_version_prefix
        or not toolchain_contract.ncu_version_matches(
            ncu_probe.get("observed"), sidecar_authorities.ncu_version_prefix,
        )
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
            "retained preflight NCU version binding",
        )

    repository_path = _V3_LABEL_DRIVER_REPOSITORY_PATH.as_posix()
    driver_payload = _git_blob_bytes(
        source_commit, repository_path, repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    if driver_payload is None:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_label_driver_authority_gap",
            f"missing source-bound Git blob {source_commit}:{repository_path}",
        )
    driver_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(driver_payload).hexdigest()
    if is_representative_execution_matrix(matrix):
        proof = matrix.get("carry_forward_proof")
        if not isinstance(proof, dict):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
                "representative carry_forward_proof is not an object",
            )
        proof_unsealed = {
            key: value for key, value in proof.items()
            if key != "proof_sha256"
        }
        tool_rows = proof.get("execution_tools")
        if not isinstance(tool_rows, list) or any(
            not isinstance(row, dict) for row in tool_rows
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
                "representative execution_tools is not an object array",
            )
        matches = [
            row for row in tool_rows if row.get("path") == repository_path
        ]
        if (
            proof.get("execution_commit") != source_commit
            or proof.get("proof_sha256") != canonical_sha256(proof_unsealed)
            or len(matches) != 1
            or matches[0].get("role") != "execution_tool"
            or matches[0].get("execution_sha256") != driver_sha256
            or not isinstance(matches[0].get("execution_blob"), str)
            or re.fullmatch(
                r"[0-9a-f]{40}", matches[0]["execution_blob"]
            ) is None
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
                "representative label-driver tool identity mismatch",
            )

    capture_cell_root = (
        output_root / ".sol_workload_staging" / source_commit / chunk_id
        / matrix_sha256 / "journals" / safe_name / "attempts"
        / f"attempt-{selected_attempt_ordinal:06d}" / "cells" / safe_name
    )
    return _V3ExecutionAuthorities(
        label_driver_command=str(
            (repo_root.absolute() / _V3_LABEL_DRIVER_REPOSITORY_PATH)
        ),
        label_driver_repository_path=repository_path,
        label_driver_sha256=driver_sha256,
        capture_cell_root=str(capture_cell_root),
        ncu_exporter_command=None,
        ncu_exporter_sha256=None,
        ncu_exporter_version=sidecar_authorities.ncu_version_prefix,
        ncu_exporter_gap=(
            "campaign_preflight schema v1 checks.ncu authenticates only the NCU "
            "version; it has no admitted resolved exporter path or executable "
            "SHA-256 field"
        ),
    )


def _require_v3_execution_authorities(
    authorities: _V3SidecarAuthorities,
) -> _V3ExecutionAuthorities:
    execution = authorities.execution
    if not isinstance(execution, _V3ExecutionAuthorities):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_label_driver_authority_gap",
            "v3 row-local execution authority is absent",
        )
    driver_path = Path(execution.label_driver_command)
    capture_cell_root = Path(execution.capture_cell_root)
    if (
        not driver_path.is_absolute() or ".." in driver_path.parts
        or execution.label_driver_repository_path
        != _V3_LABEL_DRIVER_REPOSITORY_PATH.as_posix()
        or tuple(driver_path.parts[-len(_V3_LABEL_DRIVER_REPOSITORY_PATH.parts):])
        != _V3_LABEL_DRIVER_REPOSITORY_PATH.parts
        or SHA256_RE.fullmatch(execution.label_driver_sha256) is None
        or not capture_cell_root.is_absolute()
        or ".." in capture_cell_root.parts
        or execution.ncu_exporter_version != authorities.ncu_version_prefix
        or (
            execution.ncu_exporter_command is not None
            and (
                not Path(execution.ncu_exporter_command).is_absolute()
                or ".." in Path(execution.ncu_exporter_command).parts
            )
        )
        or (
            execution.ncu_exporter_sha256 is not None
            and SHA256_RE.fullmatch(execution.ncu_exporter_sha256) is None
        )
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid", repr(execution),
        )
    return execution


def _load_retained_input_owner(
    campaign_root: Path,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes, dict[str, str]]:
    """Load the relocatable campaign owner marker without source-owner access."""
    _validate_owner_directory(campaign_root)
    marker_path = campaign_root / SUPPLEMENTAL_ROOT_MARKER
    payload = _read_immutable_campaign_payload(
        marker_path, role="supplemental retained input owner"
    )
    marker = _parse_canonical_object_payload(
        payload, role="supplemental retained input owner"
    )
    if set(marker) != {
        "schema_version", "root_kind", "campaign_identity",
        "campaign_identity_sha256", "created_at_utc", "root_identity_sha256",
    } or marker.get("schema_version") != 1 or marker.get(
        "root_kind"
    ) != SUPPLEMENTAL_ROOT_KIND:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_output_root_identity_invalid", repr(marker)
        )
    _verify_sealed(
        marker, "root_identity_sha256",
        code="supplemental_output_root_identity_invalid",
    )
    campaign_identity = marker.get("campaign_identity")
    if (
        not isinstance(campaign_identity, dict)
        or marker.get("campaign_identity_sha256")
        != canonical_sha256(campaign_identity)
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_output_root_identity_invalid", repr(marker)
        )
    pin = {
        "marker_name": SUPPLEMENTAL_ROOT_MARKER,
        "marker_sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
        "root_identity_sha256": marker["root_identity_sha256"],
        "campaign_identity_sha256": marker["campaign_identity_sha256"],
    }
    return marker, payload, pin


def _retained_external_reference(
    *, path: Path, campaign_root: Path, role: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes]:
    try:
        relative = path.absolute().relative_to(campaign_root.absolute())
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_input_reference_path_invalid", f"{role}: {path}"
        ) from exc
    relative = _safe_relative_path(relative.as_posix(), role=role)
    payload = _read_immutable_campaign_payload(path, role=role)
    reference = {
        "kind": "retained_external_input",
        "role": role,
        "owner_relative_path": relative.as_posix(),
        "source_name": path.name,
        "size_bytes": len(payload),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
    }
    return reference, payload


def _retained_preflight_references(
    *, campaign_root: Path, source_commit: str, chunk_id: str,
    required_sha256: set[str],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not required_sha256 or any(
        SHA256_RE.fullmatch(value) is None for value in required_sha256
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_preflight_set_invalid", repr(required_sha256)
        )
    parent = (
        campaign_root / "sol_workload_campaign/inputs/preflights"
        / source_commit / chunk_id
    )
    _walk_directory_nofollow(parent, create=False)
    if parent.is_symlink() or not parent.is_dir():
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_preflight_set_invalid", str(parent)
        )
    matches: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {
        digest: [] for digest in required_sha256
    }
    for path in _output_directory_entries(
        parent, operation="retained_preflight_directory",
    ):
        observed = _output_lstat(
            path, operation="retained_preflight_entry_lstat",
        )
        if observed is None or stat.S_ISLNK(
            observed.st_mode
        ) or not stat.S_ISREG(observed.st_mode):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_preflight_set_invalid", str(path)
            )
        reference, _payload = _retained_external_reference(
            path=path, campaign_root=campaign_root, role="preflight"
        )
        digest = reference["sha256"]
        if digest in matches:
            matches[digest].append(reference)
    if any(len(rows) != 1 for rows in matches.values()):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_preflight_set_invalid",
            repr({key: len(value) for key, value in matches.items()}),
        )
    return sorted(
        (rows[0] for rows in matches.values()),
        key=lambda row: (row["sha256"], row["owner_relative_path"]),
    )


def _campaign_input_sources(
    *, matrix_path: Path, canonical_matrix_path: Path, authority_path: Path,
    pins_path: Path, aggregate_budget_path: Path, cell_budget_path: Path,
    registry_path: Path, full_coverage_inventory_path: Path,
    live_coverage_inventory_path: Path,
    runnability_path: Path, shrink_path: Path,
    external_sources: dict[str, Path] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Path]:
    sources = {
        "supplemental_matrix": matrix_path,
        "canonical_matrix": canonical_matrix_path,
        "authority": authority_path,
        "pins": pins_path,
        "aggregate_budget": aggregate_budget_path,
        "cell_budgets": cell_budget_path,
        "metric_registry": registry_path,
        "sidecar_schema": DEFAULT_SIDECAR_SCHEMA,
        "full_coverage_inventory": full_coverage_inventory_path,
        "live_coverage_inventory": live_coverage_inventory_path,
        "runnability": runnability_path,
        "shrink_provenance": shrink_path,
    }
    for role, path in sorted((external_sources or {}).items()):
        if role in sources:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_campaign_input_role_duplicate", role
            )
        sources[role] = path
    return sources


def _reduced_source_role(
    source: dict[str, Any], *, input_kind: str,
) -> str:
    if input_kind not in {"workload", "definition"}:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_reduced_source_kind_invalid", input_kind
        )
    return f"reduced_{input_kind}_" + canonical_sha256({
        "name": source.get("name"), "sha256": source.get("sha256"),
    })


def _validate_external_reduced_source(
    *, root_identity: dict[str, Any],
    source: Any, logical: dict[str, Any], owner_marker: Any,
    input_kind: str,
) -> tuple[str, Path]:
    expected_fields = {
        "kind", "name", "sha256", "size_bytes", "owner_marker",
        "runtime_rebind",
    }
    expected_contract = {
        "workload": (
            "shrink_external_child_v1", "workload_file",
            "workload_file_sha256",
        ),
        "definition": (
            "shrink_external_definition_child_v1", "definition_file",
            "definition_file_sha256",
        ),
    }
    if input_kind not in expected_contract:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_reduced_source_kind_invalid", input_kind
        )
    kind, path_field, sha_field = expected_contract[input_kind]
    if (
        not isinstance(source, dict) or set(source) != expected_fields
        or source.get("kind") != kind
        or source.get("owner_marker") != owner_marker
        or source.get("runtime_rebind")
        != "campaign_retained_immutable_child"
        or source.get("name") != logical.get(path_field)
        or source.get("sha256") != logical.get(sha_field)
        or type(source.get("size_bytes")) is not int
        or source["size_bytes"] <= 0
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_reduced_source_contract_invalid", input_kind
        )
    try:
        payload = sol_recon.read_external_child(root_identity, source["name"])
        path = sol_recon.external_child_path(root_identity, source["name"])
    except sol_recon.PrerequisiteContractError as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_reduced_source_unreadable",
            f"{input_kind}: {exc}",
        ) from exc
    if (
        len(payload) != source["size_bytes"]
        or hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != source["sha256"]
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_reduced_source_hash_mismatch",
            f"{input_kind}: {source['name']}",
        )
    return _reduced_source_role(source, input_kind=input_kind), path


def validate_external_reduced_sources(
    matrix: dict[str, Any], *, shrink_root: Path,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Path], dict[str, dict[str, str | None]]]:
    """Read every reduced input through its bound owner dirfd exactly once."""
    try:
        root_identity = sol_recon.validate_external_campaign_root(shrink_root)
    except sol_recon.PrerequisiteContractError as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_reduced_owner_invalid", str(exc)
        ) from exc
    authority = matrix.get("reduced_proxy_authority") or {}
    owner_marker = authority.get("owner_marker")
    sources: dict[str, Path] = {}
    roles_by_variant: dict[str, dict[str, str | None]] = {}
    for variant in matrix.get("variants") or []:
        if not isinstance(variant, dict) or variant.get("cohort") != "reduced_proxy":
            continue
        logical = ((variant.get("invocation") or {}).get("logical_workload") or {})
        roles: dict[str, str | None] = {}
        source_pairs = [("workload", logical.get("external_workload_source"))]
        definition_source = logical.get("external_definition_source")
        if definition_source is not None:
            source_pairs.append(("definition", definition_source))
        else:
            roles["definition"] = None
        for input_kind, source in source_pairs:
            try:
                role, path = _validate_external_reduced_source(
                    root_identity=root_identity, source=source,
                    logical=logical, owner_marker=owner_marker,
                    input_kind=input_kind,
                )
            except WorkloadCaptureRefusal as exc:
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    exc.code,
                    f"variant={variant.get('variant_id')!r}; {exc.detail}",
                ) from exc
            prior = sources.get(role)
            if prior is not None and prior != path:
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_reduced_source_role_collision", role
                )
            sources[role] = path
            roles[input_kind] = role
        roles_by_variant[variant["variant_contract_sha256"]] = roles
    return sources, roles_by_variant


def _publish_retained_input(
    *, output_root: Path, source: Path, identity: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    relative = Path(str(identity.get("retained_owner_relative_path", "")))
    if (
        relative.is_absolute() or not relative.parts
        or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in relative.parts)
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_retained_input_path_invalid", str(relative)
        )
    target = output_root / relative
    descriptor, _absolute, observed = _open_regular_nofollow(
        source, role=str(identity.get("role", "campaign input"))
    )
    try:
        payload = bytearray()
        while True:
            block = os.read(descriptor, 1 << 20)
            if not block:
                break
            payload.extend(block)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    if (
        observed.st_size != identity.get("size_bytes")
        or hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != identity.get("sha256")
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_retained_input_source_drift", str(source)
        )
    _mkdir_nofollow(target.parent, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
        _validate_immutable_owned_file(
            target, expected_sha256=identity["sha256"],
            expected_size=identity["size_bytes"],
        )
        return
    _write_bytes_new_nofollow(
        target, payload, mode=0o444,
        operation="retained_campaign_input_publication",
    )
    _validate_immutable_owned_file(
        target, expected_sha256=identity["sha256"],
        expected_size=identity["size_bytes"],
    )


def retain_campaign_inputs(
    output_root: Path, *, campaign_identity: dict[str, Any],
    sources: dict[str, Path],
) -> None:
    identities = campaign_identity.get("input_file_identities")
    if not isinstance(identities, dict) or set(identities) != set(sources):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_campaign_input_set_mismatch",
            repr({"identities": sorted(identities or {}), "sources": sorted(sources)}),
        )
    for role in sorted(sources):
        _publish_retained_input(
            output_root=output_root, source=sources[role],
            identity=identities[role],
        )


def external_owner_namespace_contract(
    *, root: Path, role: str, marker_name: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bind every direct child of one sealed external source namespace."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_]+", role):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_owner_namespace_role_invalid", role
        )
    try:
        identity = sol_recon.validate_external_campaign_root(root)
        names = sol_recon.external_root_names(identity)
        if marker_name not in names:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_owner_namespace_marker_missing",
                f"{role}: {marker_name}",
            )
        files = []
        for name in sorted(names):
            payload = sol_recon.read_external_child(identity, name)
            files.append({
                "name": name, "size_bytes": len(payload),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
            })
    except WorkloadCaptureRefusal:
        raise
    except sol_recon.PrerequisiteContractError as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_owner_namespace_invalid", f"{role}: {exc}"
        ) from exc
    document = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "kind": RETAINED_OWNER_NAMESPACE_KIND,
        "role": role,
        "marker_name": marker_name,
        "files": files,
    }
    document["namespace_seal_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(document)
    return document


def capture_owner_namespace_contracts(
    *, roots: dict[str, Path], marker_names: dict[str, str],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    if set(roots) != {"plan", "runnability", "shrink"} or set(
        marker_names
    ) != set(roots):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_owner_namespace_set_invalid",
            repr({"roots": sorted(roots), "markers": sorted(marker_names)}),
        )
    return {
        role: external_owner_namespace_contract(
            root=roots[role], role=role, marker_name=marker_names[role]
        )
        for role in sorted(roots)
    }
