            or manifest.get("preserved_module_path")
            != bits.get("preserved_module_path")
            or manifest.get("policy") != "post_trace_module_or_typed"
            or manifest.get("outcome") != outcome
            or manifest.get("typed_reason") != reason
            or manifest.get("total_decoded") != summary.get("total_decoded")
            or manifest.get("total_unknown_encoding") != 0
        ):
            refuse(f"per-launch control binding {ordinal}")
        if outcome in _V3_SOL_CONTROL_OUTCOMES[:2]:
            if not kernels or summary["total_decoded"] <= 0:
                refuse(f"complete control payload {ordinal}")
            if outcome == _V3_SOL_CONTROL_OUTCOMES[0] and (
                bits.get("static_rebind") is not None
            ):
                refuse(f"runtime control payload {ordinal}")
            if outcome == _V3_SOL_CONTROL_OUTCOMES[1] and not isinstance(
                bits.get("static_rebind"), dict,
            ):
                refuse(f"static control payload {ordinal}")
        elif (
            kernels
            or summary["total_decoded"] != 0
            or bits.get("loaded_module_sha256") is not None
            or bits.get("preserved_module_path") is not None
            or bits.get("static_rebind") is not None
        ):
            refuse(f"typed-unavailable control payload {ordinal}")
        total_decoded += summary["total_decoded"]

    aggregate_status = (
        "complete_dynamic_launch_set"
        if complete_count == len(trace_inventory)
        else "typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set"
    )
    aggregate_reason = (
        None if complete_count == len(trace_inventory)
        else "control_launch_set_incomplete"
    )
    if (
        aggregate_bits.get("complete_control_count") != complete_count
        or aggregate_bits.get("status") != aggregate_status
        or aggregate_summary.get("total_decoded") != total_decoded
        or aggregate_manifest.get("outcome") != aggregate_status
        or aggregate_manifest.get("typed_reason") != aggregate_reason
        or aggregate_manifest.get("complete_control_count") != complete_count
        or aggregate_manifest.get("total_decoded") != total_decoded
    ):
        refuse("aggregate control state machine")


_NCU_LAUNCH_IDENTITY_KEYS = frozenset({
    "join_policy", "process_context_stream_policy", "launch_ordinal",
    "launch_identity_sha256", "kernel_name", "block_dim", "grid_dim",
    "device_id", "normalized_process_ordinal",
    "normalized_context_ordinal", "normalized_stream_ordinal",
    "runtime_module_sha256", "trace_executable_sha256",
    "ncu_executable_sha256", "ncu_report_sha256",
    "ncu_details_csv_file_sha256", "label_sidecar_sha256",
    "ncu_launch_inventory_sha256", "ncu_execution_identity_sha256",
    "requested_launch_skip", "requested_launch_count",
    "observed_launch_count", "selector_command_sha256",
    "ncu_launch_inventory_file_sha256",
    "ncu_execution_identity_file_sha256",
    "label_capture_manifest_sha256", "label_run_manifest_sha256",
    "ncu_launch_identity_sha256",
})


def _validate_result_ncu_launch_identities(
    launches: list[dict[str, Any]], *,
    verified_artifacts: VerifiedArtifactSet,
    expected_invocation: dict[str, Any], expected_row_key: dict[str, Any],
    expected_slug: str,
    expected_shape: str, expected_binary_sha256: str,
    expected_source_commit: str, expected_capture_identity_sha256: str,
    authorities: _V3SidecarAuthorities,
    repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
) -> str:
    """Rebuild the v3 ordered launch-set proof from retained artifacts."""
    artifacts = [
        snapshot.descriptor for snapshot in verified_artifacts.artifacts
    ]
    artifact_root = verified_artifacts.root
    if not artifacts:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set artifacts missing",
        )
    execution_authority = _require_v3_execution_authorities(authorities)
    if not isinstance(expected_row_key, dict):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_evidence_root_invalid",
            "matrix-bound result row key is absent",
        )
    cell_relative = Path("cells") / _safe_name(expected_row_key)

    trace_manifest_relative, trace_manifest = _result_artifact_payload(
        verified_artifacts,
        artifact_kind="trace_manifest",
        expected_relative=cell_relative / "trace_capture_manifest.json",
        json_role="retained trace manifest", canonical_json=True,
    )
    assert isinstance(trace_manifest, dict)
    if trace_manifest_relative.parent != cell_relative:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_evidence_root_invalid",
            trace_manifest_relative.as_posix(),
        )
    trace_relative = cell_relative / "trace"
    label_relative = cell_relative / "labels"
    _root_relative, root_payload = _result_artifact_payload(
        verified_artifacts,
        artifact_kind="trace_root",
        expected_relative=trace_relative / "dynamic_trace.pb",
    )
    _module_relative, module_payload = _result_artifact_payload(
        verified_artifacts,
        artifact_kind="trace_auxiliary",
        expected_relative=(
            trace_relative / "extra_info" / "traced_kernel_modules.json"
        ),
        json_role="retained trace module inventory",
    )
    assert isinstance(root_payload, bytes)
    assert isinstance(module_payload, dict)
    root = preflight._validate_root_trace_bytes(root_payload, repo_root)
    try:
        trace_inventory, trace_inventory_sha256 = (
            canonical_capture._validate_supplemental_trace_launch_inventory(
                root, artifact_root / trace_relative,
                module_inventory=module_payload,
            )
        )
    except canonical_capture.ChunkRefusal as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            f"retained trace inventory: {exc.code}",
        ) from exc
    if (
        root.get("status") != preflight.STATUS_OK
        or type(trace_manifest.get("schema_version")) is not int
        or trace_manifest.get("schema_version") != 1
        or trace_manifest.get("launch_scope") != "all_in_profiler_roi"
        or trace_manifest.get("binary_sha256") != expected_binary_sha256
        or trace_manifest.get("trace_contract_id")
        != root.get("trace_contract_id")
        or trace_manifest.get("memory_payload_classes")
        != root.get("memory_payload_classes")
        or trace_manifest.get("launch_count") != root.get("launch_count")
        or trace_manifest.get("launches") != root.get("launches")
        or trace_manifest.get("dynamic_launch_inventory") != trace_inventory
        or trace_manifest.get("dynamic_launch_inventory_sha256")
        != trace_inventory_sha256
        or len(launches) != len(trace_inventory)
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "retained trace manifest binding",
        )
    for ordinal, (launch, trace_row) in enumerate(
        zip(launches, trace_inventory, strict=True)
    ):
        if (
            launch.get("launch_ordinal") != ordinal
            or trace_row.get("launch_ordinal") != ordinal
            or launch.get("launch_identity_sha256")
            != trace_row.get("launch_identity_sha256")
            or launch.get("kernel_name")
            != (trace_row.get("module_mapping") or {}).get("kernel_name")
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"retained trace launch {ordinal}",
            )

    _validate_v3_control_artifacts(
        launches=launches,
        trace_inventory=trace_inventory,
        trace_inventory_sha256=trace_inventory_sha256,
        verified_artifacts=verified_artifacts,
        cell_relative=cell_relative,
        expected_slug=expected_slug,
        expected_invocation=expected_invocation,
    )

    identities: list[dict[str, Any] | None] = []
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(launches):
        identity = row.get("ncu_launch_identity")
        complete = row.get("ncu_label_complete") is True
        if (identity is not None) != complete:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set identity presence at launch {ordinal}",
            )
        if identity is None:
            identities.append(None)
            continue
        if not isinstance(identity, dict) or set(identity) != _NCU_LAUNCH_IDENTITY_KEYS:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set identity shape at launch {ordinal}",
            )
        unsealed = {
            key: value for key, value in identity.items()
            if key != "ncu_launch_identity_sha256"
        }
        hash_fields = (
            "launch_identity_sha256", "runtime_module_sha256",
            "trace_executable_sha256", "ncu_executable_sha256",
            "ncu_report_sha256", "ncu_details_csv_file_sha256",
            "label_sidecar_sha256", "ncu_launch_inventory_sha256",
            "ncu_execution_identity_sha256", "selector_command_sha256",
            "ncu_launch_inventory_file_sha256",
            "ncu_execution_identity_file_sha256",
            "label_capture_manifest_sha256", "label_run_manifest_sha256",
            "ncu_launch_identity_sha256",
        )
        integer_fields = (
            "launch_ordinal", "device_id", "normalized_process_ordinal",
            "normalized_context_ordinal", "normalized_stream_ordinal",
            "requested_launch_skip", "requested_launch_count",
            "observed_launch_count",
        )
        if (
            identity.get("ncu_launch_identity_sha256")
            != canonical_sha256(unsealed)
            or any(
                not isinstance(identity.get(field), str)
                or SHA256_RE.fullmatch(identity[field]) is None
                for field in hash_fields
            )
            or any(type(identity.get(field)) is not int for field in integer_fields)
            or identity.get("join_policy") != "ordered_full_launch_inventory_v3"
            or identity.get("process_context_stream_policy")
            != "report_local_first_occurrence_equivalence_v1"
            or identity.get("launch_ordinal") != ordinal
            or identity.get("launch_identity_sha256")
            != row.get("launch_identity_sha256")
            or identity.get("kernel_name") != row.get("kernel_name")
            or identity.get("ncu_report_sha256")
            != row.get("ncu_report_sha256")
            or identity.get("requested_launch_skip") != 0
            or identity.get("requested_launch_count") != len(launches) + 1
            or identity.get("observed_launch_count") != len(launches)
            or identity.get("normalized_process_ordinal") != 0
            or identity.get("normalized_context_ordinal") != 0
            or identity.get("normalized_stream_ordinal", -1) < 0
            or identity.get("device_id", -1) < 0
            or identity.get("trace_executable_sha256")
            != identity.get("ncu_executable_sha256")
            or not isinstance(identity.get("kernel_name"), str)
            or not identity["kernel_name"]
            or not identity["kernel_name"].isascii()
            or identity["kernel_name"].startswith("regex:")
            or any(
                not isinstance(identity.get(field), list)
                or len(identity[field]) != 3
                or any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in identity[field])
                for field in ("block_dim", "grid_dim")
            )
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set identity value at launch {ordinal}",
            )
        identities.append(identity)

    if all(identity is None for identity in identities):
        return trace_inventory_sha256
    if any(identity is None for identity in identities):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "partial launch-set identity",
        )
    complete_identities = [
        identity for identity in identities if identity is not None
    ]
    shared_fields = (
        "process_context_stream_policy", "trace_executable_sha256",
        "ncu_executable_sha256", "ncu_report_sha256",
        "ncu_details_csv_file_sha256", "ncu_launch_inventory_sha256",
        "ncu_execution_identity_sha256",
        "requested_launch_skip", "requested_launch_count",
        "observed_launch_count", "selector_command_sha256",
        "ncu_launch_inventory_file_sha256",
        "ncu_execution_identity_file_sha256",
        "label_capture_manifest_sha256", "label_run_manifest_sha256",
    )
    if any(
        len({identity[field] for identity in complete_identities}) != 1
        for field in shared_fields
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set shared identity drift",
        )
    shared = complete_identities[0]
    if trace_manifest.get("binary_sha256") != shared[
        "trace_executable_sha256"
    ]:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "retained trace executable binding",
        )

    def artifact_payload(
        *, artifact_kind: str, expected_relative: Path,
        expected_sha256: str | None = None,
        json_role: str | None = None,
        parser_canonical_json: bool = False,
        require_kind_singleton: bool = False,
    ) -> bytes | dict[str, Any]:
        if require_kind_singleton and sum(
            isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("artifact_kind") == artifact_kind
            for row in artifacts
        ) != 1:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"retained artifact {artifact_kind}",
            )
        _relative, payload = _result_artifact_payload(
            verified_artifacts,
            artifact_kind=artifact_kind, expected_relative=expected_relative,
            expected_sha256=expected_sha256, json_role=json_role,
            canonical_json=json_role is not None,
            canonical_json_ensure_ascii=not parser_canonical_json,
        )
        return payload

    report_snapshot = _result_artifact_record(
        verified_artifacts,
        artifact_kind="ncu_report",
        expected_relative=label_relative / "run_0_launch_set.ncu-rep",
        expected_sha256=shared["ncu_report_sha256"],
    )
    details_csv = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="ncu_details_csv",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative / "run_0_launch_set.details.csv"
        ),
        expected_sha256=shared["ncu_details_csv_file_sha256"],
    )
    details_stderr = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="ncu_details_stderr",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative / "run_0_launch_set.details.stderr"
        ),
        require_kind_singleton=True,
    )
    launch_metrics_bytes = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="ncu_launch_metrics",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative / "run_0_launch_set.launch_metrics.json"
        ),
        require_kind_singleton=True,
    )
    export_receipt = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="ncu_details_export_receipt",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative
            / "run_0_launch_set.details_export_receipt.json"
        ),
        json_role="NCU Details export receipt",
        parser_canonical_json=True,
        require_kind_singleton=True,
    )
    observation = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="ncu_launch_inventory",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative / "run_0_launch_set.launch_inventory.json"
        ),
        expected_sha256=shared["ncu_launch_inventory_file_sha256"],
        json_role="NCU launch-set inventory",
        parser_canonical_json=True,
    )
    execution = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="ncu_execution_identity",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative / "run_0_launch_set.execution_identity.json"
        ),
        expected_sha256=shared["ncu_execution_identity_file_sha256"],
        json_role="NCU launch-set execution identity",
    )
    run_manifest = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="label_run_manifest",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative / "label_run_manifest_0_launch_set.json"
        ),
        expected_sha256=shared["label_run_manifest_sha256"],
        json_role="NCU launch-set run manifest",
    )
    capture_manifest = artifact_payload(
        artifact_kind="execution_log",
        expected_relative=(
            label_relative / "label_launch_set_capture_manifest.json"
        ),
        expected_sha256=shared["label_capture_manifest_sha256"],
        json_role="NCU launch-set capture manifest",
    )
    assert isinstance(details_csv, bytes)
    assert isinstance(details_stderr, bytes)
    assert isinstance(launch_metrics_bytes, bytes)
    assert isinstance(export_receipt, dict)
    assert isinstance(observation, dict)
    assert isinstance(execution, dict)
    assert isinstance(run_manifest, dict)
    assert isinstance(capture_manifest, dict)

    try:
        details_text = details_csv.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
        derived_inventory = ncu_parser.extract_launch_observations(details_text)
        expected_unit_metrics = authorities.expected_unit_metrics
        metric_observations = ncu_parser.extract_launch_metric_observations(
            details_text,
            authorities.metric_registry,
            expected_unit_metrics,
        )
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            f"retained NCU Details CSV: {exc}",
        ) from exc
    try:
        launch_metrics = _parse_json_payload(
            launch_metrics_bytes, role="retained NCU launch metrics",
        )
    except WorkloadCaptureRefusal as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            f"retained NCU launch-set products: {exc.detail}",
        ) from exc
    try:
        if (
            not isinstance(launch_metrics, list)
            or launch_metrics != metric_observations
            or launch_metrics_bytes
            != ncu_parser._canonical_json_document_bytes(launch_metrics)
        ):
            raise ValueError("noncanonical or mismatched launch metrics")
        receipt_tool = export_receipt.get("ncu_tool")
        if not isinstance(receipt_tool, dict):
            raise ValueError("missing unsigned exporter tool identity")
        if (
            execution_authority.ncu_exporter_command is None
            or execution_authority.ncu_exporter_sha256 is None
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_ncu_exporter_authority_gap",
                execution_authority.ncu_exporter_gap
                or "independent retained NCU exporter authority is absent",
            )
        receipt_version = receipt_tool.get("version")
        if (
            receipt_version != execution_authority.ncu_exporter_version
            or receipt_version != authorities.ncu_version_prefix
        ):
            raise ValueError("unsigned exporter version authority mismatch")
        ncu_parser.validate_ncu_details_export_receipt(
            export_receipt,
            observed_report_size_bytes=report_snapshot.size_bytes,
            observed_report_sha256=shared["ncu_report_sha256"],
            csv_bytes=details_csv,
            stderr_bytes=details_stderr,
            launch_inventory_bytes=(
                ncu_parser._canonical_json_document_bytes(observation)
            ),
            launch_metrics_bytes=launch_metrics_bytes,
            expected_report_name="run_0_launch_set.ncu-rep",
            expected_csv_name="run_0_launch_set.details.csv",
            expected_stderr_name="run_0_launch_set.details.stderr",
            expected_inventory_name=(
                "run_0_launch_set.launch_inventory.json"
            ),
            expected_metrics_name="run_0_launch_set.launch_metrics.json",
            expected_source_commit=expected_source_commit,
            expected_capture_identity_sha256=(
                expected_capture_identity_sha256
            ),
            expected_ncu_bin=execution_authority.ncu_exporter_command,
            expected_ncu_cli_sha256=(
                execution_authority.ncu_exporter_sha256
            ),
            expected_ncu_version=execution_authority.ncu_exporter_version,
            expected_metric_observations=metric_observations,
        )
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            f"retained NCU launch-set products: {exc}",
        ) from exc
    if any(
        observation.get(field) != derived_inventory.get(field)
        for field in (
            "identity_columns", "launch_count", "launches",
            "launch_inventory_sha256",
        )
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "retained NCU Details CSV inventory mismatch",
        )

    try:
        observed_launches = ncu_parser.validate_launch_inventory_document(
            observation,
            expected_launch_count=len(launches),
            report_sha256=shared["ncu_report_sha256"],
            target_processes="all",
            filter_mode="global",
            replay_mode="kernel",
            cache_control="all",
            clock_control="none",
            profile_from_start=False,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            f"launch-set retained observation: {exc}",
        ) from exc

    if not isinstance(expected_slug, str) or not expected_slug:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set result slug",
        )
    for ordinal, (identity, metrics) in enumerate(
        zip(complete_identities, metric_observations, strict=True)
    ):
        sidecar = artifact_payload(
            artifact_kind="label_sidecar",
            expected_relative=label_relative / f"label_0_{ordinal}.json",
            expected_sha256=identity["label_sidecar_sha256"],
            json_role=f"NCU launch-set label sidecar {ordinal}",
        )
        assert isinstance(sidecar, dict)
        validation = label_import.validate_with_bound_authorities(
            sidecar,
            schema=authorities.sidecar_schema,
            registry=authorities.metric_registry,
        )
        if not validation.ok:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set sidecar {ordinal}: {validation.typed_reason}: "
                f"{validation.detail}",
            )
        protocol = sidecar.get("measurement_protocol") or {}
        unit_rows = sidecar.get("unit_tagged_metrics") or []
        observed_metric_names = tuple(
            row.get("ncu_metric") if isinstance(row, dict) else None
            for row in unit_rows
        )
        observed_metric_values = {
            row["ncu_metric"]: {
                "unit": row.get("unit"), "value": row.get("value"),
            }
            for row in unit_rows if isinstance(row, dict)
        }
        fractions = metrics["fraction_values"]
        try:
            toolchain_contract.require_nvcc_release(
                sidecar.get("cuda_version"),
                {
                    "major": authorities.nvcc_release[0],
                    "minor": authorities.nvcc_release[1],
                },
            )
            cuda_version_matches = True
        except toolchain_contract.CaptureToolchainContractError:
            cuda_version_matches = False
        sidecar_checks = {
            "device": sidecar.get("device") == "sm_86",
            "slug": sidecar.get("slug") == expected_slug,
            "shape": sidecar.get("shape_point") == expected_shape,
            "binary": sidecar.get("binary_sha256")
            == expected_binary_sha256,
            "repeat": sidecar.get("repeat_index") == 0,
            "launch": sidecar.get("launch_index") == ordinal,
            "clock": protocol.get("ncu_clock_control")
            == authorities.ncu_clock_control,
            "cache": protocol.get("ncu_cache_control")
            == authorities.ncu_cache_control,
            "replay": protocol.get("ncu_replay_mode")
            == authorities.ncu_replay_mode,
            "target_processes": protocol.get("ncu_target_processes") == "all",
            "filter_mode": protocol.get("ncu_filter_mode") == "global",
            "profile_from_start": protocol.get("ncu_profile_from_start") is False,
            "launch_skip": protocol.get("ncu_launch_skip") == 0,
            "launch_count": protocol.get("ncu_launch_count")
            == len(launches) + 1,
            "ncu_version": toolchain_contract.ncu_version_matches(
                sidecar.get("profiler_version"),
                authorities.ncu_version_prefix,
            ),
            "cuda_version": cuda_version_matches,
            "driver_version": sidecar.get("driver_version")
            == authorities.driver_version,
            "host_persistence": protocol.get("host_persistence_mode")
            == authorities.persistence_mode,
            "host_sm_clock": protocol.get("host_sm_clock_mhz")
            == authorities.sm_clock_mhz,
            "host_mem_clock": protocol.get("host_mem_clock_mhz")
            == authorities.mem_clock_mhz,
            "metric_names": observed_metric_names == expected_unit_metrics,
            "metric_values": observed_metric_values
            == metrics["unit_tagged_metrics"],
            "l2": sidecar.get("cache_hit_rate_l2_sector")
            == fractions["lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct"],
            "l1": sidecar.get("cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector")
            == fractions["l1tex__t_sector_hit_rate.pct"],
        }
        failed_sidecar_checks = sorted(
            name for name, passed in sidecar_checks.items() if not passed
        )
        if failed_sidecar_checks:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set sidecar binding {ordinal}: "
                f"{failed_sidecar_checks!r}",
            )

    execution_unsealed = {
        key: value for key, value in execution.items()
        if key != "identity_sha256"
    }
    controls = {
        "target_processes": "all",
        "filter_mode": "global",
        "replay_mode": authorities.ncu_replay_mode,
        "cache_control": authorities.ncu_cache_control,
        "clock_control": authorities.ncu_clock_control,
        "profile_from_start": False,
    }
    if (
        type(execution.get("schema_version")) is not int
        or execution.get("schema_version") != 1
        or execution.get("kind") != "ncu_launch_set_execution_identity_v1"
        or execution.get("executable_sha256")
        != shared["trace_executable_sha256"]
        or execution.get("process_context_stream_policy")
        != shared["process_context_stream_policy"]
        or execution.get("identity_sha256") != canonical_sha256(execution_unsealed)
        or execution.get("identity_sha256")
        != shared["ncu_execution_identity_sha256"]
        or execution.get("runtime_module_sha256s")
        != [identity["runtime_module_sha256"] for identity in complete_identities]
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set retained execution identity",
        )

    observed_streams: list[Any] = []
    launch_keys: list[tuple[Any, ...]] = []
    for ordinal, (row, identity) in enumerate(
        zip(observed_launches, complete_identities, strict=True)
    ):
        row_unsealed = {
            key: value for key, value in row.items()
            if key != "identity_sha256"
        }
        raw_identity = row.get("identity")
        if (
            row.get("report_launch_ordinal") != ordinal
            or row.get("identity_sha256") != canonical_sha256(row_unsealed)
            or not isinstance(raw_identity, dict)
            or raw_identity.get("Process ID") is None
            or raw_identity.get("Context") is None
            or raw_identity.get("Stream") is None
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set observation row {ordinal}",
            )
        try:
            observed_key = canonical_capture._observation_ncu_launch_key({
                "kernel_name_base": "mangled",
                "identity_columns": observation.get("identity_columns"),
                "identity": raw_identity,
            })
        except canonical_capture.ChunkRefusal as exc:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set observation key {ordinal}",
            ) from exc
        expected_key = (
            identity["kernel_name"], tuple(identity["block_dim"]),
            tuple(identity["grid_dim"]), identity["device_id"],
        )
        if observed_key != expected_key:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                f"launch-set sequence {ordinal}",
            )
        observed_streams.append(raw_identity["Stream"])
        launch_keys.append(expected_key)
    if len(set(launch_keys)) != len(launch_keys):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "duplicate NCU-observable launch tuple",
        )
    try:
        stream_classes = canonical_capture._normalize_report_local_ids(
            observed_streams, field="NCU stream",
        )
    except canonical_capture.ChunkRefusal as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set stream classes",
        ) from exc
    if stream_classes != [
        identity["normalized_stream_ordinal"]
        for identity in complete_identities
    ]:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set stream drift",
        )

    command = capture_manifest.get("command")
    if (
        not isinstance(command, list) or not command
        or not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in command)
        or command.count("--") != 1
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set command",
        )
    separator = command.index("--")
    app_args = command[separator + 1:]
    normalized_app_args = _normalize_v3_label_app_args(
        app_args,
        expected_invocation=expected_invocation,
        verified_artifacts=verified_artifacts,
        cell_relative=cell_relative,
        execution=execution_authority,
    )
    expected_command = [
        execution_authority.label_driver_command,
        "--target-processes", "all",
        "--filter-mode", "global",
        "--replay-mode", authorities.ncu_replay_mode,
        "--cache-control", authorities.ncu_cache_control,
        "--clock-control", authorities.ncu_clock_control,
        "--profile-from-start", "off",
        "--launch-skip", "0",
        "--launch-count", str(len(launches) + 1),
    ]
    for metric_name in expected_unit_metrics:
        expected_command += ["--unit-metric", metric_name]
    expected_command += ["--", *app_args]
    if (
        canonical_sha256(command) != shared["selector_command_sha256"]
        or normalized_app_args != expected_invocation["label_app_args"]
        or command != expected_command
        or not canonical_capture._json_exact_equal(
            capture_manifest.get("ncu_controls"), controls,
        )
        or capture_manifest.get("ncu_launch_observation_sha256")
        != observation.get("observation_sha256")
        or capture_manifest.get("ncu_execution_identity_sha256")
        != execution.get("identity_sha256")
        or not canonical_capture._json_exact_equal(
            run_manifest.get("ncu_controls"), controls,
        )
        or not canonical_capture._json_exact_equal(
            run_manifest.get("requested_launch_skip"), 0,
        )
        or not canonical_capture._json_exact_equal(
            run_manifest.get("requested_launch_count"), len(launches) + 1,
        )
        or run_manifest.get("ncu_execution_identity_sha256")
        != execution.get("identity_sha256")
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "launch-set command or manifest binding",
        )

    try:
        rebuilt_identities = canonical_capture.bind_ncu_launch_inventory_v3(
            inventory=trace_inventory,
            inventory_sha256=trace_inventory_sha256,
            inventory_launch_count=len(trace_inventory),
            ncu_observation=observation,
            trace_executable_sha256=trace_manifest["binary_sha256"],
            ncu_execution_identity=execution,
            ncu_report_sha256=shared["ncu_report_sha256"],
            ncu_details_csv_file_sha256=shared[
                "ncu_details_csv_file_sha256"
            ],
            ncu_launch_inventory_file_sha256=shared[
                "ncu_launch_inventory_file_sha256"
            ],
            ncu_execution_identity_file_sha256=shared[
                "ncu_execution_identity_file_sha256"
            ],
            selector_command_sha256=shared["selector_command_sha256"],
            label_capture_manifest_sha256=shared[
                "label_capture_manifest_sha256"
            ],
            label_run_manifest_sha256=shared["label_run_manifest_sha256"],
            label_sidecar_sha256s=[
                identity["label_sidecar_sha256"]
                for identity in complete_identities
            ],
        )
    except canonical_capture.ChunkRefusal as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            f"retained NCU/trace rebind: {exc.code}",
        ) from exc
    if rebuilt_identities != complete_identities:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            "retained NCU/trace identity drift",
        )
    return trace_inventory_sha256


def validate_result_launch_completeness(
    result: dict[str, Any], *, artifact_root: Path,
    expected_source_commit: str,
    done_schema_version: int = 3, repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
    v3_sidecar_authorities: _V3SidecarAuthorities | None = None,
    expected_cell: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    verified_artifacts: VerifiedArtifactSet | None = None,
) -> None:
    document = result.get("launch_completeness")
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", "not an object"
        )
    seal = document.get("completeness_sha256")
    unsealed = {
        key: value for key, value in document.items()
        if key != "completeness_sha256"
    }
    launches = document.get("launches")
    if (
        not isinstance(seal, str) or seal != canonical_sha256(unsealed)
        or document.get("launch_scope") != "all_in_profiler_roi"
        or document.get("contract") not in (
            canonical_capture._SOL_ALL_LAUNCH_COMPLETENESS_CONTRACT,
            canonical_capture._SOL_REPRESENTATIVE_LAUNCH_COMPLETENESS_CONTRACT,
        )
        or not isinstance(launches, list) or not launches
        or document.get("launch_inventory_sha256") is None
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", repr(seal)
        )
    if any(not isinstance(row, dict) for row in launches):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", "launch shape"
        )
    if [row.get("launch_ordinal") for row in launches] != list(
        range(len(launches))
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", "ordinals"
        )
    if done_schema_version == 3:
        if verified_artifacts is None:
            verified_artifacts = build_verified_artifact_set(
                result, root=artifact_root,
            )
        _require_verified_artifact_set(
            result, verified_artifacts, root=artifact_root,
        )
        if v3_sidecar_authorities is None:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_sidecar_authority_invalid",
                "v3 retained sidecar authorities are required",
            )
        capture_identity_sha256 = result.get("admission_run_id")
        if (
            not isinstance(expected_source_commit, str)
            or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", expected_source_commit) is None
            or not isinstance(capture_identity_sha256, str)
            or SHA256_RE.fullmatch(capture_identity_sha256) is None
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                "launch-set unsigned export authority",
            )
        binding = result.get("workload_row_binding")
        row_key = binding.get("row_key") if isinstance(binding, dict) else None
        bound_slug = row_key.get("slug") if isinstance(row_key, dict) else None
        if (
            not isinstance(bound_slug, str) or not bound_slug
            or result.get("slug") != bound_slug
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                "result slug is not bound to the workload row",
            )
        expected_invocation, expected_slug, expected_shape, expected_binary = (
            _expected_v3_result_contract(result, expected_cell)
        )
        if bound_slug != expected_slug:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_matrix_cell_mismatch", "row slug",
            )
        trace_inventory_sha256 = _validate_result_ncu_launch_identities(
            launches,
            verified_artifacts=verified_artifacts,
            expected_invocation=expected_invocation,
            expected_row_key=row_key,
            expected_slug=expected_slug,
            expected_shape=expected_shape,
            expected_binary_sha256=expected_binary,
            expected_source_commit=expected_source_commit,
            expected_capture_identity_sha256=capture_identity_sha256,
            authorities=v3_sidecar_authorities,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )
        if document.get("launch_inventory_sha256") != trace_inventory_sha256:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                "retained trace inventory seal",
            )
    elif done_schema_version == 2:
        if any("ncu_launch_identity" in row for row in launches):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                "v2 launch contains v3 identity",
            )
    else:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_schema_version_unknown",
            repr(done_schema_version),
        )
    sequence = [
        {
            "launch_ordinal": row["launch_ordinal"],
            "kernel_name": row.get("kernel_name"),
            "launch_identity_sha256": row.get("launch_identity_sha256"),
        }
        for row in launches
    ]
    trace_sequence_sha = canonical_sha256(sequence)
    if document.get("trace_launch_sequence_sha256") != trace_sequence_sha:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", "trace sequence"
        )
    counts = {
        "inventory_launch_count": len(launches),
        "trace_complete_launch_count": sum(
            row.get("trace_complete") is True for row in launches
        ),
        "ncu_label_complete_launch_count": sum(
            row.get("ncu_label_complete") is True for row in launches
        ),
        "control_complete_launch_count": sum(
            row.get("control_complete") is True for row in launches
        ),
    }
    if any(document.get(key) != value for key, value in counts.items()):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", repr(counts)
        )
    sequence_equal = (
        document.get("trace_ncu_sequence_equal") is True
        and document.get("ncu_replay_sequence_sha256") == trace_sequence_sha
    )
    representative = (
        document.get("contract")
        == canonical_capture._SOL_REPRESENTATIVE_LAUNCH_COMPLETENESS_CONTRACT
    )
    if representative:
        controls_allowed = all(
            row.get("control_complete") is True
            or (
                row.get("control_outcome")
                == "typed_unavailable_no_stable_static_module"
                and row.get("control_typed_reason") == "origin_unresolved"
            )
            for row in launches
        )
        complete = (
            counts["trace_complete_launch_count"] == len(launches)
            and counts["ncu_label_complete_launch_count"] == len(launches)
            and sequence_equal and controls_allowed
        )
    else:
        complete = (
            all(
                value == len(launches) for key, value in counts.items()
                if key != "inventory_launch_count"
            ) and sequence_equal
        )
    expected_status = (
        "complete_dynamic_launch_set" if complete
        else "typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set"
    )
    expected_disposition = "admitted" if complete else "failed"
    expected_reason = None if complete else "supplemental_dynamic_launch_set_incomplete"
    if (
        document.get("status") != expected_status
        or result.get("disposition") != expected_disposition
        or result.get("typed_reason") != expected_reason
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
            repr({
                "status": document.get("status"),
                "disposition": result.get("disposition"),
                "typed_reason": result.get("typed_reason"),
            }),
        )


def require_exact_result_membership_order(
    membership: list[dict[str, Any]], results: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Bind DONE result order to the chunk's breadth-first row sequence."""
    expected = [_row_identity(key) for key in membership]
    observed = [
        _row_identity((result.get("workload_row_binding") or {}).get("row_key"))
        for result in results
    ]
    if observed != expected or len(set(observed)) != len(observed):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_membership_order_mismatch",
            repr({"expected": expected, "observed": observed}),
        )
    return observed


def _chunk_attempt_histories(
    *, stage_root: Path, results: list[dict[str, Any]],
    canonical_matrix_sha256: str,
    canonical_matrix_seal_sha256: str,
    preflight_sha256: str, source_commit: str,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    histories: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for result in results:
        binding = result["workload_row_binding"]
        safe_name = _safe_name(binding["row_key"])
        state = _scan_journal_attempts(
            journal_dir=stage_root / "journals" / safe_name,
            expected_binding=binding,
            canonical_matrix_sha256=canonical_matrix_sha256,
            canonical_matrix_seal_sha256=canonical_matrix_seal_sha256,
            preflight_sha256=preflight_sha256, source_commit=source_commit,
        )
        completed = state["completed"]
        if completed is None:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_completed_attempt_cardinality", safe_name
            )
        selected_start, _selected_result, selected_dir = completed
        document = {
            "row_key": copy.deepcopy(binding["row_key"]),
            "selected_attempt_ordinal": selected_start["attempt_ordinal"],
            "selected_attempt_id": selected_start["attempt_id"],
            "attempts": state["attempts"],
            "attempts_sha256": canonical_sha256(state["attempts"]),
        }
        document["attempt_history_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(document)
        histories.append(document)
    return histories


def _validate_embedded_attempt_histories(
    histories: list[dict[str, Any]], *, results: list[dict[str, Any]],
    preflight_sha256s: set[str],
) -> None:
    """Validate the copied attempt chain without reopening staging paths."""
    if len(histories) != len(results):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_attempt_history_mismatch", "cardinality"
        )
    for history, result in zip(histories, results, strict=True):
        binding = result.get("workload_row_binding") or {}
        attempts = history.get("attempts")
        if (
            history.get("row_key") != binding.get("row_key")
            or not isinstance(attempts, list) or not attempts
            or history.get("attempts_sha256") != canonical_sha256(attempts)
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_attempt_history_mismatch",
                repr(binding.get("row_key")),
            )
        unsealed_history = {
            key: value for key, value in history.items()
            if key != "attempt_history_sha256"
        }
        if history.get("attempt_history_sha256") != canonical_sha256(
            unsealed_history
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_attempt_history_mismatch", "history seal"
            )
        selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for ordinal, attempt in enumerate(attempts, start=1):
            if not isinstance(attempt, dict):
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_done_attempt_history_mismatch", "attempt type"
                )
            unsealed_attempt = {
                key: value for key, value in attempt.items()
                if key != "attempt_summary_sha256"
            }
            if (
                attempt.get("attempt_ordinal") != ordinal
                or attempt.get("attempt_summary_sha256")
                != canonical_sha256(unsealed_attempt)
                or (
                    attempt.get("capture_preflight_sha256") is not None
                    and attempt.get("capture_preflight_sha256")
                    not in preflight_sha256s
                )
            ):
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_done_attempt_history_mismatch",
                    f"attempt {ordinal}",
                )
            if attempt.get("state") == "complete":
                selected.append(attempt)
        if (
            len(selected) != 1
            or history.get("selected_attempt_ordinal")
            != selected[0].get("attempt_ordinal")
            or history.get("selected_attempt_id")
            != selected[0].get("attempt_id")
            or result.get("capture_preflight_sha256")
            != selected[0].get("capture_preflight_sha256")
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_attempt_history_mismatch", "selected attempt"
            )


def _bind_v3_result_execution_authorities(
    *, sidecar_authorities: _V3SidecarAuthorities,
    matrix: dict[str, Any], matrix_sha256: str, chunk_id: str,
    result: dict[str, Any], histories: list[dict[str, Any]],
    preflight_payloads: dict[str, bytes], repo_root: Path,
) -> _V3SidecarAuthorities:
    binding = result.get("workload_row_binding")
    row_key = binding.get("row_key") if isinstance(binding, dict) else None
    matching_histories = [
        history for history in histories
        if isinstance(history, dict) and history.get("row_key") == row_key
    ]
    preflight_sha256 = result.get("capture_preflight_sha256")
    if (
        not isinstance(row_key, dict)
        or len(matching_histories) != 1
        or not isinstance(preflight_sha256, str)
        or SHA256_RE.fullmatch(preflight_sha256) is None
        or preflight_sha256 not in preflight_payloads
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
            "result attempt/preflight authority selection",
        )
    execution = _load_v3_execution_authorities(
        matrix=matrix,
        preflight_payload=preflight_payloads[preflight_sha256],
        source_commit=matrix.get("source_commit"),
        chunk_id=chunk_id,
        matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
        row_key=row_key,
        selected_attempt_ordinal=matching_histories[0].get(
            "selected_attempt_ordinal"
        ),
        sidecar_authorities=sidecar_authorities,
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    return replace(sidecar_authorities, execution=execution)


def build_done_manifest(
    *, chunk: dict[str, Any], results: list[dict[str, Any]],
    source_commit: str, matrix_path: Path, matrix: dict[str, Any],
    canonical_matrix_path: Path, canonical_matrix: dict[str, Any],
    authority_path: Path, pins_path: Path, aggregate_budget_path: Path,
    cell_budget_path: Path, registry_path: Path, preflight_path: Path,
    final_dir: Path, command: str,
    flashinfer_proof: dict[str, Any],
    stage_root: Path,
    publication_root: Path,
    campaign_root: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    del command  # Commands are machine-local execution context, not evidence identity.
    campaign_root = (
        Path(campaign_root) if campaign_root is not None
        else final_dir.parents[1]
    )
    owner_marker, _owner_payload, owner_pin = _load_retained_input_owner(
        campaign_root
    )
    campaign_identity = owner_marker["campaign_identity"]
    identities = campaign_identity.get("input_file_identities")
    if (
        campaign_identity.get("source_commit") != source_commit
        or not isinstance(identities, dict)
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "campaign identity"
        )
    input_references: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    input_payloads: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    for role, identity in sorted(identities.items()):
        if not isinstance(identity, dict) or identity.get("role") != role:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_input_reference_invalid", repr(role)
            )
        reference = _portable_input_reference(identity)
        input_references[role] = reference
        input_payloads[role] = _read_portable_input_reference(
            reference, campaign_root=campaign_root, repo_root=REPO_ROOT,
            source_commit=source_commit,
        )
    current_preflight_reference, current_preflight_payload = (
        _retained_external_reference(
        path=preflight_path, campaign_root=campaign_root, role="preflight"
        )
    )
    required_roles = {
        "authority", "pins", "aggregate_budget", "cell_budgets",
        "metric_registry", "sidecar_schema", "full_coverage_inventory",
        "live_coverage_inventory", "runnability", "shrink_provenance",
        "supplemental_matrix", "canonical_matrix",
    }
    if not required_roles <= set(input_references):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch",
            repr(sorted(required_roles - set(input_references))),
        )
    v3_sidecar_authorities = _load_v3_sidecar_authorities(input_payloads)
    try:
        retained_matrix = _parse_canonical_object_payload(
            input_payloads["supplemental_matrix"], role="supplemental matrix"
        )
        retained_canonical = _parse_canonical_object_payload(
            input_payloads["canonical_matrix"], role="canonical matrix"
        )
    except WorkloadCaptureRefusal:
        raise
    if retained_matrix != matrix or retained_canonical != canonical_matrix:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "matrix data model"
        )
    membership = copy.deepcopy(chunk["rows"])
    require_exact_result_membership_order(membership, results)
    retained_chunk, retained_resolved = select_workload_chunk(
        retained_matrix, retained_canonical, chunk["chunk_id"],
    )
    if retained_chunk != chunk:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "chunk data model",
        )
    matrix_sha256 = input_references["supplemental_matrix"]["sha256"]
    expected_rows = {
        _row_identity(row["key"]): (
            workload_row_binding(
                matrix=retained_matrix,
                matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
                chunk_id=chunk["chunk_id"],
                row=row,
            ),
            cell,
        )
        for row, _variant, cell in retained_resolved
    }
    retained_bytes = sum(
        sum(item["size_bytes"] for item in result["artifacts"])
        for result in results
    )
    canonical_matrix_sha256 = input_references["canonical_matrix"]["sha256"]
    attempt_histories = _chunk_attempt_histories(
        stage_root=stage_root, results=results,
        canonical_matrix_sha256=canonical_matrix_sha256,
        canonical_matrix_seal_sha256=canonical_matrix[
            "matrix_seal_sha256"
        ],
        preflight_sha256=current_preflight_reference["sha256"],
        source_commit=source_commit,
    )
    attempt_preflight_sha256s = {
        attempt["capture_preflight_sha256"]
        for history in attempt_histories
        for attempt in history["attempts"]
        if attempt.get("capture_preflight_sha256") is not None
    }
    preflight_references = _retained_preflight_references(
        campaign_root=campaign_root, source_commit=source_commit,
        chunk_id=chunk["chunk_id"],
        required_sha256=attempt_preflight_sha256s,
    )
    preflight_payloads = {
        reference["sha256"]: _read_portable_input_reference(
            reference, campaign_root=campaign_root, repo_root=REPO_ROOT,
            source_commit=source_commit, verify_git_provenance=False,
        )
        for reference in preflight_references
    }
    if preflight_payloads.get(current_preflight_reference["sha256"]) != (
        current_preflight_payload
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_tool_authority_invalid",
            "selected retained preflight bytes changed",
        )
    _validate_embedded_attempt_histories(
        attempt_histories, results=results,
        preflight_sha256s={
            reference["sha256"] for reference in preflight_references
        },
    )
    publication_storage = _tree_usage(publication_root / "cells")
    dispositions: dict[str, int] = {}
    launch_counts = {
        "complete_dynamic_launch_set_rows": 0,
        "typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set_rows": 0,
        "inventory_launches": 0,
        "trace_complete_launches": 0,
        "ncu_label_complete_launches": 0,
        "control_complete_launches": 0,
    }
    for result in results:
        binding = result.get("workload_row_binding")
        key = _row_identity(
            binding.get("row_key") if isinstance(binding, dict) else None
        )
        expected_row = expected_rows.get(key)
        if expected_row is None or binding != expected_row[0]:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_binding_mismatch", repr(key),
            )
        row_v3_authorities = _bind_v3_result_execution_authorities(
            sidecar_authorities=v3_sidecar_authorities,
            matrix=retained_matrix,
            matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
            chunk_id=chunk["chunk_id"],
            result=result,
            histories=attempt_histories,
            preflight_payloads=preflight_payloads,
            repo_root=REPO_ROOT,
        )
        verified_artifacts = build_verified_artifact_set(
            result, root=publication_root,
        )
        validate_result_launch_completeness(
            result, artifact_root=publication_root,
            expected_source_commit=source_commit,
            done_schema_version=3,
            v3_sidecar_authorities=row_v3_authorities,
            expected_cell=expected_row[1],
            verified_artifacts=verified_artifacts,
        )
        _verify_artifacts(
            result, root=publication_root,
            verified_artifacts=verified_artifacts,
        )
        value = result.get("disposition")
        dispositions[value] = dispositions.get(value, 0) + 1
        completeness = result.get("launch_completeness") or {}
        status = completeness.get("status")
        if status == "complete_dynamic_launch_set":
            launch_counts["complete_dynamic_launch_set_rows"] += 1
        elif status == "typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set":
            launch_counts["typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set_rows"] += 1
        else:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid",
                repr(result.get("workload_row_binding", {}).get("row_key")),
            )
        for source, destination in (
            ("inventory_launch_count", "inventory_launches"),
            ("trace_complete_launch_count", "trace_complete_launches"),
            ("ncu_label_complete_launch_count", "ncu_label_complete_launches"),
            ("control_complete_launch_count", "control_complete_launches"),
        ):
            value = completeness.get(source)
            if type(value) is not int or value < 0:
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", source
                )
            launch_counts[destination] += value
    manifest = {
        "schema_version": 3,
        "manifest_kind": "sol_workload_capture_chunk_done",
        "chunk_id": chunk["chunk_id"],
        "cohort": chunk["cohort"],
        "source_commit": source_commit,
        "generated_at_utc": _utc_text(),
        "publication_relative_path": (
            Path("sol_workload_chunks") / chunk["chunk_id"]
        ).as_posix(),
        "retained_input_owner": owner_pin,
        "supplemental_matrix": {
            "input_role": "supplemental_matrix",
            "sha256": input_references["supplemental_matrix"]["sha256"],
            "matrix_seal_sha256": matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
        },
        "canonical_matrix": {
            "input_role": "canonical_matrix",
            "sha256": input_references["canonical_matrix"]["sha256"],
            "matrix_seal_sha256": canonical_matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
        },
        "flashinfer_corpus": flashinfer_done_proof(flashinfer_proof),
        "inputs": input_references,
        "preflights": preflight_references,
        "chunk_membership": membership,
        "chunk_membership_sha256": canonical_sha256(membership),
        "row_count": len(membership),
        "counts": dict(sorted(dispositions.items())),
        "launch_counts": launch_counts,
        "retained_artifact_bytes": retained_bytes,
        "publication_storage": publication_storage,
        "attempt_histories": attempt_histories,
        "cell_results": results,
    }
    manifest["done_seal_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(manifest)
    _validate_done_schema(manifest)
    return manifest


def verify_done_manifest(
    manifest: dict[str, Any], *, final_dir: Path,
    matrix: dict[str, Any] | None = None, matrix_path: Path | None = None,
    canonical_matrix: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    canonical_matrix_path: Path | None = None,
    campaign_root: Path | None = None, repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
    require_current_state: bool = True,
    require_final_location: bool = True,
    verify_git_provenance: bool = False,
) -> None:
    del matrix_path, canonical_matrix_path
    version = manifest.get("schema_version")
    if type(version) is not int:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_schema_version_unknown", repr(version)
        )
    if version == 2:
        done_schema_version = _validate_done_schema(manifest)
    elif version == 3:
        done_schema_version = _validate_source_bound_v3_done_schema(
            manifest, repo_root=repo_root,
        )
    else:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_schema_version_unknown", repr(version)
        )
    _verify_sealed(
        manifest, "done_seal_sha256", code="supplemental_done_seal_mismatch"
    )
    campaign_root = (
        Path(campaign_root) if campaign_root is not None
        else final_dir.parents[1]
    )
    relative_publication = _safe_relative_path(
        manifest.get("publication_relative_path"), role="DONE publication"
    )
    expected_relative = Path("sol_workload_chunks") / manifest["chunk_id"]
    if (
        relative_publication != expected_relative
        or (
            require_final_location
            and final_dir.absolute()
            != (campaign_root / relative_publication).absolute()
        )
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_publication_path_mismatch", str(final_dir)
        )
    owner_marker, _owner_payload, owner_pin = _load_retained_input_owner(
        campaign_root
    )
    campaign_identity = owner_marker["campaign_identity"]
    if (
        manifest.get("retained_input_owner") != owner_pin
        or campaign_identity.get("source_commit") != manifest["source_commit"]
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "retained input owner"
        )
    identities = campaign_identity.get("input_file_identities")
    if not isinstance(identities, dict):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "input identities"
        )
    expected_references = {
        role: _portable_input_reference(identity)
        for role, identity in sorted(identities.items())
        if isinstance(identity, dict)
    }
    references = manifest.get("inputs")
    if references != expected_references:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "input references"
        )
    input_payloads = {
        role: _read_portable_input_reference(
            reference, campaign_root=campaign_root, repo_root=repo_root,
            source_commit=manifest["source_commit"],
            verify_git_provenance=verify_git_provenance,
        )
        for role, reference in sorted(references.items())
    }
    v3_sidecar_authorities = (
        _load_v3_sidecar_authorities(input_payloads)
        if done_schema_version == 3 else None
    )
    preflight_references = manifest.get("preflights")
    if not isinstance(preflight_references, list):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "preflight references"
        )
    preflight_sha256s: set[str] = set()
    preflight_paths: set[str] = set()
    preflight_payloads: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    expected_preflight_prefix = (
        "sol_workload_campaign", "inputs", "preflights",
        manifest["source_commit"], manifest["chunk_id"],
    )
    for reference in preflight_references:
        relative = _safe_relative_path(
            reference.get("owner_relative_path")
            if isinstance(reference, dict) else None,
            role="preflight",
        )
        if (
            not isinstance(reference, dict)
            or reference.get("kind") != "retained_external_input"
            or reference.get("role") != "preflight"
            or relative.parts[:5] != expected_preflight_prefix
            or len(relative.parts) != 6
            or reference.get("source_name") != relative.name
            or reference.get("sha256") in preflight_sha256s
            or relative.as_posix() in preflight_paths
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "preflight reference"
            )
        payload = _read_portable_input_reference(
            reference, campaign_root=campaign_root, repo_root=repo_root,
            source_commit=manifest["source_commit"],
            verify_git_provenance=False,
        )
        preflight_sha256s.add(reference["sha256"])
        preflight_paths.add(relative.as_posix())
        preflight_payloads[reference["sha256"]] = payload
    if preflight_references != sorted(
        preflight_references,
        key=lambda row: (row["sha256"], row["owner_relative_path"]),
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "preflight reference order"
        )
    retained_matrix = _parse_canonical_object_payload(
        input_payloads["supplemental_matrix"], role="supplemental matrix"
    )
    retained_canonical = _parse_canonical_object_payload(
        input_payloads["canonical_matrix"], role="canonical matrix"
    )
    if matrix is not None and matrix != retained_matrix:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "supplemental matrix object"
        )
    if canonical_matrix is not None and canonical_matrix != retained_canonical:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "canonical matrix object"
        )
    matrix = retained_matrix
    canonical_matrix = retained_canonical
    supplemental_schema = _read_source_bound_matrix_schema(
        matrix=matrix,
        source_commit=manifest["source_commit"],
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    _validate_schema_document(
        matrix, supplemental_schema, code="supplemental_done_input_mismatch",
    )
    if (
        campaign_identity.get("supplemental_matrix_sha256")
        != references["supplemental_matrix"]["sha256"]
        or campaign_identity.get("supplemental_matrix_seal_sha256")
        != matrix.get("matrix_seal_sha256")
        or campaign_identity.get("canonical_matrix_sha256")
        != references["canonical_matrix"]["sha256"]
        or campaign_identity.get("canonical_matrix_seal_sha256")
        != canonical_matrix.get("matrix_seal_sha256")
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "campaign matrix pins"
        )
    chunks = [
        row for row in matrix["chunks"]
        if row["chunk_id"] == manifest["chunk_id"]
    ]
    _chunk, _resolved = select_workload_chunk(
        matrix, canonical_matrix, manifest["chunk_id"]
    )
    flashinfer = manifest.get("flashinfer_corpus")
    if not isinstance(flashinfer, dict):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "FlashInfer proof"
        )
    flashinfer_unsigned = {
        key: value for key, value in flashinfer.items()
        if key != "corpus_identity_sha256"
    }
    if (
        flashinfer.get("corpus_identity_sha256")
        != canonical_sha256(flashinfer_unsigned)
        or flashinfer.get("root_repo_path")
        != "data/annex/flashinfer_trace"
        or flashinfer.get("data_annex_manifest_path")
        != "evidence/manifests/data_annex.sha256"
        or flashinfer.get("data_annex_manifest_sha256")
        != sol_recon.DATA_ANNEX_MANIFEST_SHA256
        or flashinfer.get("filtered_manifest_sha256")
        != sol_recon.FLASHINFER_CORPUS_MANIFEST_SHA256
        or flashinfer.get("file_count") != sol_recon.FLASHINFER_CORPUS_FILE_COUNT
        or flashinfer.get("safetensors_count")
        != sol_recon.FLASHINFER_CORPUS_BLOB_COUNT
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", "FlashInfer proof"
        )
    _validate_embedded_attempt_histories(
        manifest["attempt_histories"], results=manifest["cell_results"],
        preflight_sha256s=preflight_sha256s,
    )
    if (
        len(chunks) != 1
        or manifest["chunk_membership"] != chunks[0]["rows"]
        or manifest["chunk_membership_sha256"]
        != canonical_sha256(manifest["chunk_membership"])
        or manifest["supplemental_matrix"] != {
            "input_role": "supplemental_matrix",
            "sha256": references["supplemental_matrix"]["sha256"],
            "matrix_seal_sha256": matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
        }
        or manifest["canonical_matrix"] != {
            "input_role": "canonical_matrix",
            "sha256": references["canonical_matrix"]["sha256"],
            "matrix_seal_sha256": canonical_matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
        }
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_input_mismatch", str(final_dir)
        )
    expected_key_sequence = require_exact_result_membership_order(
        manifest["chunk_membership"], manifest["cell_results"]
    )
    expected_keys = set(expected_key_sequence)
    result_keys: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
    artifact_total = 0
    dispositions: dict[str, int] = {}
    launch_counts = {
        "complete_dynamic_launch_set_rows": 0,
        "typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set_rows": 0,
        "inventory_launches": 0,
        "trace_complete_launches": 0,
        "ncu_label_complete_launches": 0,
        "control_complete_launches": 0,
    }
    rows_by_key = {
        _row_identity(row["key"]): row for row in matrix["rows"]
    }
    cells_by_key = {
        _row_identity(row["key"]): cell
        for row, _variant, cell in _resolved
    }
    matrix_sha = references["supplemental_matrix"]["sha256"]
    for result in manifest["cell_results"]:
        binding = result.get("workload_row_binding") or {}
        key = _row_identity(binding.get("row_key"))
        if key in result_keys:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_result_duplicate", repr(key)
            )
        result_keys.add(key)
        matrix_row = rows_by_key.get(key)
        expected_binding = (
            workload_row_binding(
                matrix=matrix, matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
                chunk_id=manifest["chunk_id"], row=matrix_row,
            ) if matrix_row is not None else None
        )
        if binding != expected_binding:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_binding_mismatch", repr(key)
            )
        expected_cell = cells_by_key.get(key)
        if expected_cell is None:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_binding_mismatch", repr(key)
            )
        row_v3_authorities = v3_sidecar_authorities
        if done_schema_version == 3:
            assert v3_sidecar_authorities is not None
            row_v3_authorities = _bind_v3_result_execution_authorities(
                sidecar_authorities=v3_sidecar_authorities,
                matrix=matrix,
                matrix_sha256=matrix_sha,
                chunk_id=manifest["chunk_id"],
                result=result,
                histories=manifest["attempt_histories"],
                preflight_payloads=preflight_payloads,
                repo_root=repo_root,
            )
        verified_artifacts = build_verified_artifact_set(
            result, root=final_dir,
        )
        validate_result_launch_completeness(
            result, artifact_root=final_dir,
            expected_source_commit=manifest["source_commit"],
            done_schema_version=done_schema_version, repo_root=repo_root,
            v3_sidecar_authorities=row_v3_authorities,
            expected_cell=(expected_cell if done_schema_version == 3 else None),
            verified_artifacts=verified_artifacts,
        )
        artifact_total += _verify_artifacts(
            result, root=final_dir,
            verified_artifacts=verified_artifacts,
        )
        disposition = result.get("disposition")
        dispositions[disposition] = dispositions.get(disposition, 0) + 1
        completeness = result.get("launch_completeness") or {}
        status = completeness.get("status")
        if status == "complete_dynamic_launch_set":
            launch_counts["complete_dynamic_launch_set_rows"] += 1
        elif status == "typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set":
            launch_counts["typed_incomplete_dynamic_launch_set_rows"] += 1
        else:
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", repr(key)
            )
        for source, destination in (
            ("inventory_launch_count", "inventory_launches"),
            ("trace_complete_launch_count", "trace_complete_launches"),
            ("ncu_label_complete_launch_count", "ncu_label_complete_launches"),
            ("control_complete_launch_count", "control_complete_launches"),
        ):
            value = completeness.get(source)
            if type(value) is not int or value < 0:
                raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                    "supplemental_done_launch_completeness_invalid", repr(key)
                )
            launch_counts[destination] += value
    if (
        result_keys != expected_keys
        or manifest["row_count"] != len(expected_keys)
        or manifest["counts"] != dict(sorted(dispositions.items()))
        or manifest["launch_counts"] != launch_counts
        or manifest["retained_artifact_bytes"] != artifact_total
        or manifest["publication_storage"] != _tree_usage(final_dir / "cells")
    ):
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_done_result_mismatch", str(final_dir)
        )
    if require_current_state:
        environment = os.environ.copy()
        for name in (
            "GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES", "GIT_COMMON_DIR", "GIT_DIR",
            "GIT_INDEX_FILE", "GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY", "GIT_PREFIX",
            "GIT_WORK_TREE",
        ):
            environment.pop(name, None)
        head_result = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, env=environment,
        )
        status_result = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "status", "--porcelain=v1",
             "--untracked-files=all"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, env=environment,
        )
        head = head_result.stdout.strip()
        dirty = status_result.stdout.splitlines()
        if (
            head_result.returncode != 0 or status_result.returncode != 0
            or head != manifest["source_commit"] or dirty
        ):
            raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
                "supplemental_done_source_state_invalid",
                f"head={head}; dirty={dirty!r}",
            )


def _certify_environment(
    *, supplemental_matrix: dict[str, Any], supplemental_matrix_path: Path,
    preflight_manifest: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, str]]:
    environment_matrix = supplemental_matrix
    if is_representative_execution_matrix(supplemental_matrix):
        environment_matrix = {
            **supplemental_matrix,
            "schema_version": 2,
            "artifact_id": sol_environment.SUPPLEMENTAL_MATRIX_ARTIFACT_ID,
        }
    try:
        probe, environment = sol_environment.certify_supplemental_sol_environment(
            environment_matrix, matrix_path=supplemental_matrix_path,
            ambient=os.environ,
        )
    except sol_environment.SolEnvironmentRefusal as exc:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(exc.code, exc.detail) from exc
    sealed = preflight_manifest["checks"]["sol_environment"]
    stable_fields = (
        "ambient", "environment_contract", "environment_contract_sha256",
        "constructed_environment_delta", "matrix_pin", "matrix_sha256",
        "observed_fingerprint", "compiler_identity", "nvcc_release",
        "nvcc_version_output",
    )
    drift = [name for name in stable_fields if probe.get(name) != sealed.get(name)]
    if drift:
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "SUPPLEMENTAL_SOL_ENV_PREFLIGHT_DRIFT", repr(drift)
        )
    return probe, environment


def _validate_supplemental_preflight_reference(
    *, preflight_path: Path, preflight_sha256: str,
    pins: dict[str, Any], pins_path: Path,
    aggregate_budget_path: Path,
    supplemental_matrix: dict[str, Any], supplemental_matrix_path: Path,
    supplemental_matrix_sha256: str, output_root: Path,
    expected_head: str, require_fresh: bool,
    admitted_at_utc: datetime,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bind preflight to the live matrix; frozen canonical bytes are context."""
    return canonical_capture._validate_referenced_preflight(
        preflight_path=preflight_path, expected_sha256=preflight_sha256,
        pins=pins, pins_path=pins_path,
        aggregate_budget_path=aggregate_budget_path,
        matrix=supplemental_matrix, matrix_path=supplemental_matrix_path,
        matrix_sha256=supplemental_matrix_sha256,
        output_root=output_root, expected_head=expected_head,
        require_fresh=require_fresh, admitted_at_utc=admitted_at_utc,
    )


def _capture_one(
    *, journal_dir: Path, cell: dict[str, Any], binding: dict[str, Any],
    supplemental_runnability_evidence: dict[str, Any] | None,
    canonical_matrix: dict[str, Any], pins: dict[str, Any], cell_budgets: Any,
    preflight_manifest: dict[str, Any], preflight_path: Path,
    preflight_sha256: str, matrix_sha256: str, cell_budget_sha256: str,
    raw_staging_margin_bytes: int, source_commit: str,
    sol_environment_probe: dict[str, Any],
    certified_sol_env: dict[str, str], output_root: Path,
    aggregate_budget: dict[str, Any],
    flashinfer_proof: dict[str, Any],
    canonical_matrix_sha256: str,
    expected_sol_fingerprint_pin: dict[str, Any],
    pins_sha256: str,
    runnability_path: Path | None = None,
    supplemental_workload_path: Path | None = None,
    supplemental_definition_path: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    safe_name = _safe_name(binding["row_key"])
    _mkdir_nofollow(journal_dir, exist_ok=True)
    if journal_dir.is_symlink() or not journal_dir.is_dir():
        raise WorkloadCaptureRefusal(
            "supplemental_journal_path_invalid", str(journal_dir)
        )
    state = _scan_journal_attempts(
        journal_dir=journal_dir, expected_binding=binding,
        canonical_matrix_sha256=canonical_matrix_sha256,
        canonical_matrix_seal_sha256=canonical_matrix[
            "matrix_seal_sha256"
        ],
        preflight_sha256=preflight_sha256, source_commit=source_commit,
    )
    if state["completed"] is not None:
        return state["completed"][1]
    for _ordinal, prior_dir in _attempt_directories(journal_dir):
        _seal_attempt_tree(prior_dir)
    attempts_root = journal_dir / "attempts"
    _mkdir_nofollow(attempts_root, exist_ok=True)
    attempt_ordinal = state["next_ordinal"]
    attempt_id = hashlib.sha256(uuid.uuid4().bytes).hexdigest()
    attempt_dir = attempts_root / f"attempt-{attempt_ordinal:06d}"
    admission_run_id = hashlib.sha256(uuid.uuid4().bytes).hexdigest()
    _mkdir_nofollow(attempt_dir, exist_ok=False)
    preflight_copy = attempt_dir / "capture_preflight.json"
